This door, which looked like a KTV entrance with its sofa-like leather upholstery, was actually made of iron! No wonder that young man had personally opened and closed it when they first came in!
Su Malie might not have realized what was happening, but her two bodyguards certainly did. They had been on edge ever since Jing Shu voiced her suspicions. Now that something seemed to be genuinely wrong, they immediately readied their rifles, one of them moving to shield Su Malie.
"Still trying to sneak away? With those shifty eyes, you don’t look like a good person. Tell me, what were you planning to do by blocking the signal?"
"Let go of me, you damn street punk!" Fatty howled. "Our signal here comes and goes, you know? Let go of me first! We can talk this out nicely. You’re holding guns; you’ve scared all my guys! Let me go, and I’ll open the door for you. If you want to leave, then hurry up and go, alright?"
"Who are you kidding? The signal was full strength a moment ago, and now it’s gone in an instant? After the apocalypse, all mobile communications merged into one company; the signal is incredibly strong," Jing Shu sneered.
"Jing Shu, maybe we should let him go first and see what he has to say. Uncle Gou also said the oil had arrived. They can’t possibly be playing tricks, right?" Su Malie said from the side, somewhat perplexed.
Actually, it seemed like nothing was wrong, but Jing Shu had been acting strangely all morning.
"Your Uncle Gou isn’t acting normally either. The more I think about it, the more suspicious it seems. I’m worried he might have defected, been bought off, perhaps?" Jing Shu asked, furrowing her brow.
She had trusted Uncle Gou as one of Su Malie’s people from the beginning, which was why she had overlooked many details. Sometimes, a stab in the back is the most terrifying.
Fatty panted heavily, unable to move. He clenched his teeth and struggled, but the woman’s grip was like iron pincers.
He couldn’t believe a woman could be this strong!
"Impossible. Uncle Gou has been with me for nine years since he retired. He’s absolutely considered one of our own family. Money and treasures can’t sway him, and he has no family. Why would he defect? Besides, my father said that once he completes ten years of service, he’ll grant him that wish he made back then. The time is almost up; Uncle Gou’s wish is about to come true. The cost of his betrayal would be too high."
Su Malie categorically denied it.
The bodyguards behind her might defect, but someone as close as a personal steward would never betray her.
Was she just being too sensitive?
Jing Shu slowly let go of Fatty.
If Uncle Gou definitely wasn’t the problem, then the oil had indeed arrived. But the signal was absolutely being blocked. Were these people trying to lure Uncle Gou away, to draw the tiger from the mountain? But what good would luring Uncle Gou away do? Once he realized his young lady was kidnapped, wouldn’t he have to attempt a rescue? Then they would all be doomed.
If they simply wanted to kill someone, they’d had countless opportunities. This meant killing wasn’t the objective; they must be after something else.
"I advise you to behave. Don’t even think about opening that door and running off on your own," Jing Shu said, drawing a handgun from her waist and pressing it to the back of Fatty’s head. "Go on, open the door. If I’ve really misunderstood you, I’ll compensate you with two Blood Mushrooms later."
Jing Shu gestured for those behind her to follow.
There was no telling if a bunch of AKs would be aimed at them as soon as Fatty opened the door. Jing Shu was even considering quietly slipping on her bulletproof vest. She had to complain about those vests; although they stopped bullets, getting hit still damn well hurt!
"I won’t try anything funny! You guys are seriously paranoid, completely nuts! Would a big boss like me bother with such petty stuff?" Fatty grumbled as he walked towards the door normally, Jing Shu’s handgun still aimed at the back of his head.
If Fatty could still pull any tricks under these circumstances...
Just as she was thinking this, Fatty suddenly—WHOOSH!—disappeared!
So fast that no one had time to react!

chapters.title: Chapter 256: Trapped in an Oxygen-Deprived Chamber
chapters.content:
Chapter 256: Trapped in an Oxygen-Deprived Chamber
Afterward, a faint thud sounded.
"Damn it!"
Jing Shu stamped her foot in frustration. She only had time to see Fatty disappear in an instant before the floor tiles where he had stood returned to their original state. She did not know how he had activated the mechanism.
It must be similar to the principle behind the trapped wooden board at the entrance of Jing Shu’s villa, which could only be opened from one side. Or maybe Fatty had already activated it and slowly made his way across.
In any case, Jing Shu’s reflexes were not quick enough to keep up; otherwise, she would have shot him on the spot. Who the hell expected a person to suddenly vanish while walking with a gun pointed at them? That Fatty could now have his boxed lunch – such great acting! One second he was cursing, and the next, he made his underground escape!
Well played, it must have been premeditated.
Su Malie truly was a walking soap opera. Even here, she encountered a mechanism straight out of a TV show!
To think that Jing Shu, who had lived what felt like a dog’s life for two lifetimes, had never come across such a device.
"He’s gone, escaped. We might be trapped in this house now. Let’s look for a way out." Jing Shu tucked her gun behind her and squatted down to knock on the floor tiles. They were solid, just like those around them, not hollow.
One bodyguard began checking for mechanisms in the corners while another tried to find a way out through the door.
Su Malie walked to the door, curious, and asked, "Wang Chuan, you’re trained in emergency escape skills, right? Can this door be opened?"
The middle-aged man with a beard shook his head. "It’s a stainless steel vault door, solid all the way through, with active bolts that latch into fixed slots on the outside. It can’t be opened from the inside. Even if we used rifles, they’d be useless; we wouldn’t even be able to penetrate the door. It’s unlike other doors where you can simply shoot out the lock. If I’m not mistaken, this was once a casino vault, specifically for storing money."
Jing Shu kicked the door several times forcefully, and a dull thud echoed. If it had been an ordinary wooden door, she would have smashed it by now.
"So you mean the bolts are on the outside, and the door can’t be shot through. Escaping through this door is impossible then?" Jing Shu asked, narrowing her eyes.
Wang Chuan nodded. "Yes, and moreover, we might run out of air in here if the people outside don’t open the door for us soon. We could very likely suffocate to death."
"Then could explosives blow the door open?" Jing Shu inquired. If it came to it, she was willing to use explosives to blow the door open. She couldn’t bear the thought of just waiting to die. It was too passive, especially since she didn’t know Fatty and the others’ true intentions. Jing Shu had already died once, which made her particularly fearful of death.
However, it’s very likely they’re after Su Malie. As for herself... it probably doesn’t have much to do with her, right?
Wang Chuan shook his head. "The amount of explosives it would take to blow open the door would also kill us. There’s nowhere to hide in here."
Alright, Jingshu’s space still contained several explosives, acquired from Zhetian before.
Su Malie’s eyes widened in fear. "No wonder they kept the door open... Da Mao, have you found the passage mechanism that Fatty used to escape?"
The bodyguard named Da Mao, a steadfast man in his early thirties, shook his head. "I checked for any dangers right as we came in and didn’t find any switches or surveillance bugs. Fatty didn’t touch anything just now, so it’s very likely it was voice-activated, or maybe... centrally controlled. Vaults usually have a central control system."
Su Malie let out a long sigh. "If only we had brought a satellite device, at least we could have called for help. Now we’re trapped here. Even if big data has our last known location, who could find us in a secret room of an underground gambling den in an abandoned manor? I wonder how Uncle Gou is doing."
After the four of them had thoroughly searched the secret room and found nothing, they became even more frantic. Just as Wang Chuan said, being in a completely sealed space without ventilation for a long time could indeed lead to a lack of oxygen.
At least Jing Shu felt that even after taking a deep breath, she still couldn’t catch her breath.
"Miss, drink some warm water first, then lie down on the sofa without moving, and don’t eat anything to reduce the oxygen demand caused by digestive movement," Da Mao settled Su Malie first. After all, Su Malie couldn’t be of any help and would be better off lying down quietly, not consuming oxygen.
"Do you want to lie down as well?" Da Mao asked.
"No need, I’ll think of another way." Jing Shu was now suspicious of everyone and didn’t trust anyone. Even though Su Malie said that Uncle Gou would definitely not betray them, she still felt that something had gone wrong somewhere.
Now Jing Shu truly regretted not having stored some climbing oxygen tanks in her Jingshu’s space. Those would have been life-saving! Who could have expected to encounter a lack of oxygen after being reborn? She had planned for myriad possibilities but did not foresee being caught in such a trap! Indeed, there are countless ways to die, and one is bound to encounter one of them sooner or later!
Even if she took them out now, they would be very curious. After all, it would be strange to carry an oxygen tank when just going out.
"Then I’ll leave it to you guys. I’ll rest for a bit." After finishing the water, Su Malie lay down on the sofa to rest. She truly had a relaxed disposition. Perhaps she hadn’t faced many setbacks from childhood to adulthood, as there were always people around her to help her overcome any difficulties, leading her to trust that the people around her could handle everything.
Jing Shu felt that they couldn’t just sit around and wait to die. Since there was no way out through the door, they might as well try to escape through the hole Fatty fell through.
If there was any real danger below... well, that would be a job for the professional bodyguards, to clear any hazards.
"What tools do you all have? Do you have professional pry bars, gadgets, or picks and hammers?" Jing Shu asked.
"I have a set of wilderness survival tools with me, but they’re not much use against this kind of heavy-duty secret room." Da Mao took out a set of advanced tools: a Swiss Army knife, flashlight, multifunctional hammer and chisel, steel drill bits, and so on.
Jing Shu was somewhat surprised.
This could work. Dripping water can pierce stone.
What came next truly astonished the two retired individuals.
God, what were they seeing?
This girl, who appeared almost as delicate as the Miss, started by chiseling a shallow pit and then hammered in the steel drill bit as if it were a nail. Despite the tiny hammer in her hand, it seemed to carry the force of hundreds of kilograms. She forcefully hammered the drill bit into the ground, pulled it out, and continued to chisel. Soon, she had carved out a square section of floor tile.
It was the first time the two had seen a drill bit being used as a nail.
Just how strong was Jing Shu, exactly?
The sounds of CLINKING and CLANGING rang out, and Wang Chuan could even see sparks flying! The chisel was about to bend under her force! Jing Shu gasped for breath, sweating profusely.
One by one, Jing Shu forcibly pried up the floor tiles. Finally, when breathing became extremely difficult for her, she managed to completely chisel open an 80 by 80 centimeter floor tile that was 20 centimeters thick.

chapters.title: Chapter 257: Elevator Thriller
chapters.content:
Chapter 257: Elevator Thriller
This was supposed to be a stuck mechanized floor tile, yet Jing Shu pried it open bit by bit with sheer force! The person who designed this mechanism probably never anticipated that someone would forcefully pry it open instead of using a switch.
Indeed, beneath it was a standard controller for opening and closing, with obvious seams! Jing Shu hammered down on it with the drill bit, and the seam slowly widened!
Due to the vigorous exertion, Jing Shu started to experience oxygen deprivation, and her consciousness began to blur. Nevertheless, she persisted. Every pore of her body yearned for fresh air. Breathing like a bellows, she relived the imminent approach of death from her previous life, which made her push even harder!
And at that moment, she felt something unusual about the Magic Cube Space in her mind!
But Jing Shu didn’t have time to check on the Magic Cube Space.
Finally, with the two bodyguards also joining in to help, with a BANG, the mechanism’s panel was violently dismantled and fell.
The secret passage below opened!
Jing Shu inhaled deeply, feeling an unprecedented sense of well-being. Every pore in her body seemed to open up, bringing a dreamlike comfort, but her head still spun as if she were about to ascend to the heavens.
If she had to describe it, it was like having a 40-degree Celsius fever. Her feet felt like they were floating off the ground, walking made her feel like she was swirling, and people’s words sounded as if heard in a dream.
"Jing Shu? Jing Shu?"
"Let’s go; we’re heading down. Wang Chuan and Da Mao have already gone. Jing Shu? Are you feeling unwell? Don’t scare me," Su Malie said, shaking Jing Shu. Having just woken up, Su Malie felt no discomfort. Jing Shu, however, had been exercising vigorously under extreme oxygen deprivation, leading to hallucinations and auditory illusions.
"Oh, okay."
Jing Shu felt as if everything were a dream, not very real. She didn’t even know how she’d climbed down. She faintly remembered Su Malie yelling at her to hold onto the rope, so she grabbed it.
Jing Shu knew that continuing like this was no good; she had to save herself.
So, she drank half a drop of undiluted spiritual spring water.
The anticipated intense hunger did not come. Although her head still spun violently, Jing Shu knew the effects of the Spiritual Spring must be working elsewhere. At this moment, her life was the most important thing.
So, she steeled herself and drank another drop of spiritual spring water."We must find the exit as soon as possible," Wang Chuan said. "We are now walking down a passage without an elevator. If an ’elevator’ were to come barreling down on us, we might all be done for here."
Two steel ropes in the passage suggested that the fat man must have ’taken the elevator’ down. Jing Shu was still in a delirious state.
If she were lucid, she would have been extremely surprised to find several passages underground, hinting at a vast network with unknown destinations.
Jing Shu’s actions today were like chiseling open a firmly shut elevator door. But with no elevator inside, the group proceeded down, following the elevator’s hoist ropes, possibly reaching the third floor, or maybe the second.
"I’m just worried there might be another door like this at a different exit, and we’d need to break through it again," Wang Chuan said. "No matter what, we must find the exit. Da Mao, the first thing to do once we find an exit is to contact Mr. Su. If something happens later, I’ll cover our retreat."
"Bro..."
"You still have Ermao and Sanmao to take care of at home; you’re the hope of your family."
The passage was long. Initially, there were two or three branches and turns, but without exception, each was sealed by a heavy-duty door with a locking mechanism that was impossible to open. After trying many methods in vain, the group had no choice but to continue forward.
Usually, at the end of such a passage, whether it was the top or bottom of an elevator shaft, one could climb out because it would just be a frame structure.
Jing Shu’s consciousness had not recovered. In fact, she didn’t even know if her condition was worsening, as she increasingly felt as if she were dreaming. The sensation was so surreal. She even discovered something terrifying – had she lost her sense of pain?
She pinched herself hard but then forgot whether she actually had or not.
Had she pinched herself... or not?
Jing Shu drank another drop of the spiritual spring water.
But what exactly was happening to her body? Why was the Spiritual Spring, which was supposed to heal all ailments, having no effect on her? Jing Shu had always wondered what the thought process of a person in a vegetative state was like, and now she probably knew. It felt like her mind was clear, but when it came to performing any action, she just couldn’t do it.
Just a moment ago, Jing Shu had been overwhelmingly strong; now, she needed to rely on Su Malie to walk.
"Jing Shu, just hold on a little longer! Hold on, and as soon as we get out, I’ll find you a Doctor immediately!" Su Malie urged.
Initially, she had thought Jing Shu was just lacking oxygen and would be fine after resting for a while. Even Wang Chuan had said it was a symptom of oxygen deprivation and had given Jing Shu a bottle of mineral water. But it seemed to be of no use, and Jing Shu’s condition was only getting worse!
"Jing Shu... Shushu... Shushu..."
It seemed to Jing Shu that someone was calling her, but every word sounded drawn out, and she couldn’t make them out clearly. Was her condition getting even worse?
"We’re almost there! We’ve almost reached the bottom!" Wang Chuan’s excited voice came through. "Be careful, that’s the thruster’s frame! Once we climb under that, we’ll reach the exit!"
However, just at that moment, a CREAKING sound came from behind them, followed by the rapid movement of the two nearby ropes. Although they couldn’t see the elevator, the moving ropes indicated that an elevator was rapidly hurtling towards them.
"Run!"
"Run!"
Wang Chuan’s voice reached them, and Su Malie, pulling Jing Shu, ran towards the lowest point, with Da Mao and Wang Chuan following close behind.
"Run another hundred meters! Run and then jump over!"
Jing Shu also started running. She ran instinctively, her pace surprisingly fast—even faster than Su Malie’s. In fact, she ended up leading Su Malie.
But with four people squeezed into the narrow passage, they couldn’t move very fast. Even though a hundred meters sounded close, it felt like an eternity spent running on the brink of death.
And does a normal elevator even move that fast? It felt terrifying, like a vertical lift plummeting from above! There wasn’t even the sensation of a steady speed, was there?!
The most critical point was that those two hoist ropes were moving way too fast. It was as if the Grim Reaper itself were chasing them!
They made it!
The only spot of light in the entire passage was the exit!
Jump!
Jing Shu was the first to leap out. Su Malie followed right after, jumping across. But at that very moment, the thruster elevator from above crashed down.
How fast does an object fall from a great height?
It’s so fast that by the time you realize it, it has already hit the ground. In less than two seconds, from sighting it to impact, it smashed down with a DEAFENING CRASH.
Da Mao leaped out right behind them. Immediately afterward, a HUGE BOOM resounded, so fast it was impossible to react even with the blink of an eye.

chapters.title: Chapter 258: Finally Took Off the Human Skin Mask
chapters.content:
Chapter 258: Finally Took Off the Human Skin Mask
It was clear this wasn’t the elevator’s normal operating speed; someone had deliberately made it accelerate. Cold sweat began to form on Da Mao’s forehead.
This means the enemy came prepared,
he realized.
A tremendous roar made the entire underground passage tremble violently. Small pieces of debris flew haphazardly, instantly creating several cuts on the dazed Jing Shu’s body and face. Blood flowed into Jing Shu’s mouth. She licked it and found it strangely delicious.
"Wang Chuan? Where’s Wang Chuan?"
"Wang Chuan didn’t make it out!"
Gasping for breath, Su Malie ran incredulously toward the opening from which they had just escaped. The elevator, speeding down at high velocity, slammed into the brace of the propulsion device. Su Malie peered inside but saw nothing except for an exposed section of an arm, wearing the Swiss watch she had given Wang Chuan.
The bearded man was completely crushed beneath the elevator, very likely flattened into a meat patty.
The elevator itself was nearly totaled. It was empty! Someone had intentionally controlled it! Could it be that someone already knew they had escaped?
Jing Shu walked over in a daze. Although she was aware of what was happening outside, it seemed she couldn’t control her body and was moving solely on instinct.
Su Malie covered her mouth with her hands, tears streaming down instantly. How could this be possible? How could this happen? Wang Chuan was just speaking to her moments ago.
Why didn’t he manage to run out?
Da Mao was also panting heavily, his lips pursed tightly. "Bro... don’t worry, I’ll ensure the Miss is safe." He had no time for sorrow. He took out his phone and saw there was still no signal. "Miss, we need to find an exit quickly. There are likely people nearby. Here," he said, offering her a handgun, "take this. If anything seems wrong, shoot immediately."
Da Mao became even more cautious. Now he was the only one the other two could rely on. He picked up a few pebbles and began to scout ahead. Fortunately, the end of the propulsion device should have been the exit.
Da Mao positioned Su Malie and Jing Shu behind him, shielding them as he opened the door at the end.
A creaking noise sounded. It was pitch black inside. Nothing could be seen. Da Mao didn’t dare turn on a flashlight for fear of alerting the enemy, so he could only toss a few small pebbles in different directions, using the echoes to scout the way.
The bewildered Jing Shu continued to wander in her trance. If she had been lucid at this moment, perhaps what followed would never have happened.
"Let’s go. Be careful, and stay close to the wall." Da Mao entered first without incident. Su Malie, holding Jing Shu, followed quietly.
But just then, the entire hall suddenly lit up with blinding light.
"Run back!" Da Mao had just shouted when he heard the POP-POP of gunfire. Without a second thought, he forcefully pushed Su Malie and Jing Shu out the door.
Then, the sound of gunfire continued unabated, but after four or five seconds, it stopped. Everything had ended.
Da Mao had been shot into a sieve. He slowly collapsed, blood pooling around him. He pointed weakly in Su Malie’s direction. "Miss, run! Quickly! If you make it out, look after Ermao and Sanmao for me..." Having struggled to say these last words, Da Mao’s head tilted to one side, and he died.
"Sob... Okay, I understand..."
Su Malie, trembling, rose from the ground. Her yellow flared dress was now filthy and disheveled; even her meticulously painted nails had split and cracked. She looked at the suddenly illuminated room in disbelief, pointing at the middle-aged man who, assault rifle slung over his shoulder, looked pleased with his shooting.
"You? Is it you? Uncle Gou, is it really you? How is this possible? It can’t be!" Her voice rose to a heart-wrenching cry. For someone of Su Malie’s background, betrayal was the most unacceptable thing.
Wasn’t this man Uncle Gou?
Jing Shu was also shoved to the ground. This push finally triggered something within her, breaking a certain limit. The series of interconnected events finally pierced through the paper-thin barrier of the Magic Cube Space! It had finally met all conditions for an upgrade!
An unprecedented force began to wildly invade Jing Shu’s mind. Unable to bear it, she fainted once more.
Each upgrade of the Magic Cube Space was like rebooting a computer or smartphone—it required a shutdown and restart. Jing Shu ’rebooted’ at such a critical moment, truly leaving her fate to the heavens.
However, this upgrade was entirely different from the previous ones. Jing Shu was consciously receiving information transmitted to her from the Magic Cube Space. While the Magic Cube Space was upgrading, she could still hear the voices from outside.
Most unbelievably, it seemed she was having an Illusion. She could see her Magic Cube Space visibly expanding, one cubic meter at a time. And Jing Shu could actually see the Magic Cube Space in its Second Form, now completely overlapping with the real world.
It was more like her soul had left her body. She could even see her own fainted self on the ground, Da Mao lying there, Su Malie sobbing bitterly, and the people opposite them. Of course, she could also see the overlapping Magic Cube Space reorganizing itself. The white points of light grew bit by bit, like photons in a science fiction movie.
It’s so magical!
So this was how the Magic Cube Space had upgraded in the past.
Meanwhile, Su Malie was truly isolated and helpless. Jing Shu had fainted, her two bodyguards were dead, and the ever-trusted Uncle Gou turned out to be the orchestrator of this event.
How could this be possible?
At this moment, she was on the brink of collapse.
"Uncle Gou? Oh, your ever-loyal Uncle Gou? Sadly, he met a very tragic end."
The middle-aged man pushed his hair back and slowly began to peel a mask from his face.
"He hasn’t been your Uncle Gou for two months. Didn’t you notice at all?"
"What?!" Su Malie exclaimed in shock. "Impossible! He’s been with me day and night. How could it be?"
The man, having peeled off the mask, revealed a young face. Jing Shu, in her soul-out-of-body-like state, saw it with utter clarity.
This person... isn’t this Lin Yi, the one she monitored every day?!
It was him! It was actually him!
Jing Shu was so shocked she didn’t know what to say.
How could it be him? How could one person play two roles? The Lin Yi she monitored every day hadn’t shown any abnormal behavior... Wait, that was too normal, too ordinary. Could it be he knew she had been monitoring him all along?
Right, that’s why Gou Su seemed so tall! His silhouette had always felt a bit familiar. But Uncle Gou was muscular, a completely different build from the tall, thin Lin Yi she’d seen before the New Year.
"Why impossible? I started imitating him three months ago. I kidnapped him and brought him to my home two months ago. It took a great deal of effort to learn everything about him. Now, I can finally take off this human skin mask," Lin Yi said, beginning to peel the mask from his neck...

chapters.title: Chapter 259: Lin Yi Sets the Trap
chapters.content:
Chapter 259: Lin Yi Sets the Trap
Under the bright lights, the scene was terrifying. Fatty, standing beside Lin Yi, charged with his gun and snatched Su Malie’s weapon before she could react. Then he ran over to Jing Shu and kicked her twice. "She’s fainted! Must’ve been from the lack of oxygen earlier. That damn old hag hurt me so bad."
Jing Shu thought,
Wait until I wake up and see how I’ll deal with you.
And so, Jing Shu finally understood why Lin Yi’s physique had changed so much—it was actual, damned skin. She couldn’t tell how each piece adhered so tightly to Lin Yi’s body, but from the outside, it looked seamless.
Lin Yi tore off chunks of flesh and tossed them carelessly to the ground—it was real human skin.
If Uncle Gou hadn’t betrayed them, then everything would make sense now,
Jing Shu mused.
Lin Yi planned this from the start, bringing Su Malie to the auction, then intentionally trapping her in the house. As for what he wants to do next, that’s unknown. So, that raises the question: am I just an innocent bystander caught in the crossfire? I always said never to get involved with Su Malie, or else... one would encounter all sorts of troubles.
"You’re not my Uncle Gou! Who are you? What have you done to Uncle Gou!" Su Malie screamed hoarsely.
"This skin... isn’t it your Uncle Gou’s?" Lin Yi replied with a sunny smile. He adopted the same casual demeanor as on the day Grandma Jing fainted, his hand resting nonchalantly in his pocket, just as it had when he’d offered his opinion on her collapse—as if discussing some trivial little thing.
"Do you know, Miss, how much effort I put into becoming your Uncle Gou? To make his skin look indistinguishable from an ordinary person’s, I used many drugs. I especially boiled many medicinal concoctions to prolong Uncle Gou’s life. This was so that after I cut off his skin while he was alive, I could ensure it stayed fresh and didn’t rot. Only then, when wearing a suit made of real human skin, would there be nothing amiss."
"To create a parasitic body, one must use a living person. Your Uncle Gou was no good anymore after being skinned halfway... after all, few other young men could last that long. But I learned all of Uncle Gou’s secrets. It was very fortunate indeed that the plan was executed six months early. Otherwise, there would have been no suitable person left."
"Oh, I should also be grateful to those who tried to capture me. I haven’t properly thanked them yet. Last year, they forced me to create human skins that helped them successfully infiltrate the United States—a great move indeed. Too bad no one knows I was the one who made the skins! I’ll be sure to return the favor to them properly."
"So, you see, creating human skins really takes a lot of effort. For this plan, I had to take off the skin suit every day and then put it back on..."
Su Malie, covering her mouth with her hands, could no longer contain herself and began to vomit.
That was Uncle Gou’s body she had interacted with for nine years! And now... it was presented before her in such a manner. What was more terrifying was that for these past two months, she had been interacting with someone who wasn’t Uncle Gou, and she hadn’t even noticed! Uncle Gou met such a horrible death, skinned bit by bit and turned into a human skin suit... I never even saw him one last time! How much pain must he have endured?
She sobbed.
Meanwhile, Jing Shu felt a chill run down her spine.
I finally understand why Lin Yi kept coming home with bags of medicine over the last two months,
she thought.
At the time, I was curious: why did he carry home a bag of medicine every day? Yes, it was him, without a doubt—the behind-the-scenes boss from my past life who had caused widespread chaos and ruled with an iron fist. His death wasn’t reported until several years later; it was said he escaped numerous times after being caught. Even while heavily guarded, the police had no idea how he managed to escape! What other cards does he have up his sleeve? The man is highly intelligent, a quick learner with a wide range of knowledge—it’s as if he can do anything. He’s especially terrifying when it comes to manipulating people’s hearts. So frightening that even Grandma Jing was utterly charmed by him! So frightening that he stirred up turmoil in multiple countries!
And it seems there’s more to the story of Yang Yang going to the United States and disguising himself as an American. It’s very likely related to Lin Yi being captured and forced to help Yang Yang and others make human skin masks. But how did this person manage to escape later on? He was supposedly tied up by a group of strong men. How could he have possibly gotten away? He must have a big secret!
Jing Shu found herself undeniably curious.
Su Malie wiped away her tears and collapsed onto the damp ground. Pointing at Lin Yi, she sobbed and asked, "Uncle Gou underwent Level 12 pain training of all kinds! Torture could never have worked on him, let alone him telling you everything. He could have bitten his tongue to commit suicide; he could even have controlled his own consciousness to induce mental death! How on earth did you do it?"
Lin Yi scoffed. "Aren’t you curious why I pretended to be your Uncle Gou?"
"It was just to kidnap me! So many people have tried to kidnap me since I was a child, but no one has ever truly succeeded. Not if I don’t want them to!" Su Malie’s voice suddenly rose, filled with her characteristic sharpness. She exuded a potent confidence, as if believing that if she didn’t wish for something, it simply couldn’t be made to happen. She saw herself as a goddess who ruled her own fate.
This was the indomitable confidence Su Malie had cultivated from a young age: if she didn’t want something to happen, it wouldn’t. She was just that formidable.
"Tsk, tsk. You really are narcissistic." Lin Yi shook his head. "Kidnapping you? I could have done that on the first day. But that would have been too unchallenging and meaningless."
"Then, what is it for? Do you want to kill my father?!" Su Malie exclaimed in terror.
"Why couldn’t you have just stayed in that private room and slept soundly? I never intended to make things difficult for you. After all, you were just a small catalyst..." Lin Yi mused, his steps deliberate and oppressive as he advanced.
Su Malie shuffled backward, bit by bit, a genuine fear finally gripping her.
Jing Shu frowned, pondering Lin Yi’s words.
So, what exactly is Lin Yi’s goal in setting up such an elaborate scheme? And am I, Jing Shu, just an insignificant pawn in this game? If so, how can I save myself and steer clear of these murky waters?
Jing Shu had always felt that Lin Yi was playing with fire, an incredibly dangerous game.
The things he sets out to do are never without danger—inciting public sentiment, causing widespread unrest, and so on. The schemes he’s plotting might be even grander.
"You should get some sleep. When you wake up, you might get to see a good show." Lin Yi pressed a towel over Su Malie’s mouth, and she, too, passed out.
At that moment, Lin Yi walked step by step towards Jing Shu.
Jing Shu’s heartbeat quickened.
Lin Yi had reverted to his tall and lean stature. Jing Shu noticed the well-defined muscles on his body, a testament to his extreme self-discipline and rigorous daily exercise regimen.
A man who is harsh on himself is even harsher on others! What is he going to do?

chapters.title: Chapter 260: Magic Cube Space’s New Ability?
chapters.content:
Chapter 260: Magic Cube Space’s New Ability?
"The person who could kill Shangguan Jun just faints from lack of oxygen so easily? You must be hiding plenty of secrets too, you know? Shangguan Jun was a crucial pawn in Zhetian. You say you..." Lin Yi pulled the trigger of the gun on his chest, pointing it at Jing Shu’s head as he fell into deep thought.
Jing Shu’s heart pounded wildly.
Could her luck be this bad? Please, I still have some value! Let’s talk this out!
The poor Jing Shu couldn’t react at all. If at this moment her Magic Cube Space and reality perfectly overlapped, she might be able to manipulate the gun in the Magic Cube Space and shoot Lin Yi dead.
"Huh, she’s not faking it." Unsure of what he had thought, Lin Yi suddenly holstered his gun and crouched down to turn the fainted Jing Shu over.
He examined Jing Shu closely. Her face, covered in blood that had already clotted, was more bedraggled than Su Malie’s. Lin Yi’s fingers pressed on Jing Shu’s neck and nostrils and opened her eyelids to take a closer look, causing him to frown again.
It wasn’t caused by a lack of oxygen!
"What’s the matter, boss? Want to kill this busybody? Let me do it!" Saying this, he prepared to kick her, but a look from Lin Yi stopped him.
Lin Yi waved his hand. "I still have use for this woman." With that, Lin Yi began to search her. Unfortunately, all he found were military knives, daggers, and tools—nothing useful. Lin Yi frowned in confusion.
She doesn’t have a gun on her? No dangerous items? It can’t be! Maybe she lost them along the way?
Jing Shu also slowly exhaled a breath of relief, thankful she had the habit of always keeping valuable items in her space. Usually, when she needed something, she’d pretend to reach into her pocket while actually retrieving the item from her space. Her phone also held many secrets, so she always stored these important items in her space. It had become instinctive for her to go through the motion of reaching into a pocket before daring to pull anything out.
No, I should be grateful that I’m still a bit useful, so I haven’t been killed!
"Forget it, lock them up here. You keep an eye on them. Also, clear out the passageway outside; don’t let it interfere with the plans that follow." Lin Yi stood up, squinting his eyes. He pondered for a bit, and added, "Be very careful, because this woman is the murderer who killed Shangguan Jun. You know Shangguan Jun, right?"
Fatty’s teeth chattered.
Of course, I know!
"Don’t worry, boss. I’ll be careful. Once they’re tied up here, they won’t be going anywhere," Fatty fervently promised.
But once the boss leaves, I’ll do whatever I want! I can act as I please!
Su Malie is untouchable; she’s a hostage. But what about this little shrimp next to her?
HEHEHE! Fatty was already envisioning his delightful life.
Lin Yi nodded, gathered all the guns, and walked out the door of the underground passage. Finally, he took two tiny surveillance devices and stuck them at the doorway before completely leaving.
Let me see, what secrets do you really hold? My favorite thing to do is ’fight fire with fire’. If I hadn’t been so vigilant, ensuring my life and actions were strictly monitored around the clock, this woman might have already discovered something.
Lin Yi hummed a tune, thinking to himself.
Lin Yi knew exactly what kind of person Fatty was.
I deliberately left Fatty behind to cause trouble. I want to see how Jing Shu will resist in a situation with no outside help.
He was quite looking forward to it.
Lin Yi had left. His movements of stealthily placing something at the door before he left did not escape Jing Shu, who was currently in a soul-out-of-body state.
Jing Shu found it even more incredible: her field of view was identical to the one she had within her Magic Cube Space, and within this view, there were no blind spots for her.
Jing Shu didn’t know if this was a new ability her Magic Cube Space was gaining while upgrading to level 7.
In any case, in the real world overlapping with the Magic Cube Space, Jing Shu had the same God’s Eye View as she did in the Magic Cube Space, which could zoom in and rotate. When she wanted to see what Lin Yi had stuck there, the view instantly zoomed in, and she saw it was a pinhole surveillance camera!
Jing Shu had a new hypothesis:
When the Magic Cube Space fully overlaps with the real world, I’ll also have ’control’ over the part of the real world merged with it, just like I have ’Absolute Control’ within the Magic Cube Space itself.
This God’s Eye View, achieved through the overlap, might just be the beginning.
Just like in the Magic Cube Space, this ’God’s Eye View’ must be a reflection from the Magic Cube Space, transmitted into my mind. So, I’m not actually experiencing a soul out of body; what I’m seeing is merely a projection from the Magic Cube Space.
As the Magic Cube Space upgraded and expanded, her field of view expanded as well.
Lin Yi left, and Fatty called people over, binding Su Malie and Jing Shu in this underground passageway that resembled a transfer station. This place had housed many items before. Besides puddles, there were many black residues left on the ground.
What are they conspiring here?
To prevent them from escaping, Fatty chained them to a thick pillar, then rubbed his hands. "Wait for me. Once I’ve fixed the passage, we’ll come back and have some fun."
Fatty initially wanted to touch Jing Shu’s cheek, but Jing Shu, covered in blood and dirty water, looked too wretched. Disgusted, Fatty ultimately turned to work first, as Jing Shu exhaled slowly once more.
Time slowly passed, and Da Mao’s corpse in the corner attracted many apocalypse-era insects that began to devour it. Judging by this speed, Jing Shu estimated that in less than two hours, Da Mao’s body would be reduced to a skeleton, with not even blood remaining.
Until... Jing Shu’s vision gradually became blurry, the projection of the Magic Cube Space slowly shattered and collapsed. Jing Shu lost her last bit of vision and consciousness.
Information about the Magic Cube Space’s upgrade kept flooding in. Only then did Jing Shu understand:
The new field of vision was just one branch of the Magic Cube Space’s new abilities!
...
"I’m going to work myself to death today," Fatty panted, looking at the Swiss watch on his wrist with satisfaction.
Although I’m tired as a dog, the haul was good. Too bad the guns from those crushed people were also damaged, otherwise the haul would’ve been even better!
Fatty approached the two who were chained, chuckling with a grin, rubbing his hands continuously. "Little darlings, I’m here! Did you miss me a lot?"
Su Malie woke up to the noise. She opened her eyes to see such a big face approaching and screamed.
"AH!! AH!" Su Malie’s screams finally woke Jing Shu. She felt aches all over, a chilling cold, and her stomach growled with hunger; the upgrade had likely consumed a lot of her energy.
The moment her eyes opened, she also saw Fatty’s large face approaching, his groping hand nearing too.

chapters.title: Chapter 261: Magic Cube Space’s True Ability
chapters.content:
Chapter 261: Magic Cube Space’s True Ability
Su Malie struggled, and soon, her delicate hands were chafed purple-red by the restraints.
"SOB SOB SOB, don’t come over!" Su Malie yelled.
After half a year of Jing Shu’s efforts and a two-month bottleneck, the Magic Cube Space had finally upgraded to the 7th level today. Jing Shu had no time to explore its new functions, new land, or new areas.
Jing Shu struggled but couldn’t break free. Fatty truly thought highly of them, using iron chains to bind them. Right now, not only was Jing Shu’s life in danger, but someone was also trying to take advantage of her.
Just as Jing Shu subtly glanced towards the monitor, considering how to eliminate Fatty without being detected by the surveillance, Fatty suddenly stopped!
Of course, it wasn’t a change of heart on Fatty’s part. Instead, as he approached, he stepped on the horrifying insects that were chewing on Da Mao’s flesh and bones! Like ants, these insects then swarmed onto his body and started to bite.
Sometimes I truly feel Su Malie’s luck is terrifyingly good,
Jing Shu thought.
In such a desperate situation, all sorts of things can happen. Surely the goddess of luck is looking after Su Malie. Then again, perhaps it’s inevitable. Da Mao’s death attracted the insects, and anyone stepping on them would certainly get bitten.
Fate... it’s truly a mysterious thing.
Fatty slapped at his legs, bawling, "Damn it! Gouzai, Da Lv, Shou Rou, come quickly and help me!"
Four subordinates who were still working outside ran in. They quickly stripped off their clothes and started swatting at the insects on Fatty.
But the insects of the apocalypse were unlike those from before. Having evolved through the harsh selection of their environment, these insects had become the most lethal, pouncing on anything edible.
Soon, the five men were in complete disarray. Fatty cursed loudly while stomping fiercely. Together, they crushed many insects, and blood already flowed from their wounds.
Just when the group thought the insects were dealt with, several snakes slithered out from the base of the wall. They flicked their snake tongues, twisted their slender bodies, and initiated a new battle between man and snake...
Su Malie screamed. She hoped the snakes would bite all the men to death, yet she also prayed they wouldn’t come near her. Soon, her wish was granted.
Snake: Dear V8 Guest, your wish has been received.
Eventually, the snakes were either shot, killed with shovels, or slapped to death, each meeting a different end. However, the men didn’t even have time to bleed out the poison from their bites before they started to stagger, losing all strength to resist.
The Five-step Snake, known as one of the deadliest serpents, didn’t earn its reputation lightly—especially not these, which had been nourished by the Spiritual Spring in Jing Shu’s Magic Cube Space for so long!
"Good biting!"
"Well done!"
Su Malie cheered from the side. "Kill them! Wait, the Key! Where’s the Key that locks us up?"
Key: Dear V8 Guest, your wish has been received.
Jing Shu bowed her head and closed her eyes, using the true ability of her seventh-tier Magic Cube Space for the first time.
Indeed, if the abilities of the sixth-tier Magic Cube Space had been sealed, then reaching the seventh tier was like unsealing it, releasing its true powers.
Jing Shu finally understood why her consciousness had been blurred and her mind foggy before the Magic Cube Space upgraded. She had been completely caught in an Illusion, unable to distinguish reality from dreams. This was because the ability derived from her seventh-tier Magic Cube Space was to inflict a severe perceptual disorder—Illusions—upon creatures within its domain.
Simply put, it was the ability to control creatures’ thoughts and, ultimately, their actions.
Jing Shu also understood why she felt a strong compulsion to wake up at 4 a.m. every day to practice with the Magic Cube; it was all due to the Magic Cube’s new ability.
At the same time, Jing Shu realized that the Magic Cube Space’s previous abilities must have been unsealed, allowing this new ability to evolve—an ability she desperately needed.
Previously, she had to spend half a year living alongside the Bees to control them. She also had to feed the fat chicken a large amount of Spiritual Spring to establish a master-servant relationship. These were the methods she used before her Illusion ability was unsealed.
She had been with the Five-step Snakes for two months without establishing a relationship and still couldn’t control them, which greatly disappointed Jing Shu.
But from now on, having advanced her Magic Cube Space to the seventh tier, Jing Shu no longer worried about these issues.
As Jing Shu understood it, her current Magic Cube Space could now directly allow her to implant suggestions and cause perceptual disorders in the creatures within. It was essentially like telling them:
Jing Shu is your master; you must obey Jing Shu.
Therefore, right after the Magic Cube Space upgraded, Jing Shu immediately established a connection with the snakes within it, able to receive their feedback and directly command them. They slithered from the base of the walls to fight fiercely with the men, ultimately ending in mutual destruction.
Yes,
Jing Shu mused,
if they hadn’t all perished, wouldn’t it be suspicious for those snakes to have spared Su Malie and me?
Previously, she could only unilaterally suggest the snakes bite someone but couldn’t command how they should attack or fight. That former ability could only be called ’suggestion’; now, it had escalated to ’control.’
Now, after the upgrade, Jing Shu could not only control these snakes but also receive feedback on their actions and even see through their eyes. Using them as Scouts to explore paths would be extremely useful—far more flexible and effective for surveillance than any camera.
This is the Illusion ability, causing cognitive disorders in the creatures of the Magic Cube Space. It might sound like a trivial power, but it’s actually incredible. It feels like I am the master of everything within this space!
As for the real world that overlapped with the Magic Cube Space, Jing Shu naturally couldn’t be so brazen as to directly control people. However, she could inflict minor cognitive disorders on them, influence them with suggestions, and produce momentary Illusions.
So... she activated the Magic Cube Space’s Illusion ability. This made Fatty, who had the Key, hallucinate that his only path to survival was to reach Su Malie. And so... Fatty stumbled, fell onto Su Malie, successfully dropped the Key, and then collapsed. Su Malie thus obtained the Key with ease.
The ability to create Illusions, even if just for a moment or to influence a minor decision, is incredibly powerful,
Jing Shu thought.
It’s definitely one of my trump cards now. In critical moments, this kind of Illusion can be life-saving; it can even influence so many things.
...
The monitor broadcast the recent scene.
"So, that’s how it is," Lin Yi remarked, tapping the table rhythmically. After several months with her, he had come to understand this young lady’s uncanny abilities. He had even, out of disbelief, subjected her to a horrifying elevator ordeal. Yet, even in that supposedly fatal situation, she had emerged unscathed. He had set an ambush for her with a gun, but she had still effortlessly escaped.

chapters.title: Chapter 262: I suspect that this passage leads directly to Qian Duoduo’s house
chapters.content:
Chapter 262: I suspect that this passage leads directly to Qian Duoduo’s house
These murderous insects and snakes seemed to be rushing to save her.
Does such a lucky person truly exist in the world?
However, what was impossible? If she was Heaven’s favored individual, then he must be the Child of Heaven’s Abandonment. Su Malie had luck by her side, but he was haunted by nightmares. He also possessed a secret ability unknown to the world; it was his trump card for survival, a life-preserving technique, and one of his biggest secrets thus far.
Therefore, Lin Yi didn’t take Su Malie’s terrifying luck to heart; he even had no intention of harming her in this plan. To him, she was merely bait and a pawn.
Those who act will fail, and those who cling will lose. For someone like Su Malie, one should avoid her sharp edge and keep a respectful distance.
"So it really is a troublesome matter," Lin Yi sighed. He had wanted to see what secrets the woman who killed Shangguan Jun possessed. He hadn’t expected that without him interfering with Su Malie’s affairs, Su Malie would still resolve them on her own.
This time, Jing Shu hadn’t shown any special qualities, appearing as if she were just an ordinary, inconsequential bystander...
Like him, Shangguan Jun was a meticulous person, most skilled in ambushes and stealth attacks. No one would joke with their own life; under such circumstances, Shangguan Jun had died in the pit he had set for others. Either he had been discovered in advance—although this possibility was slim—or his sneak attack had failed.
That made Lin Yi even more curious.
Jing Shu must have a decisive ability to counter-attack and turn the tables on her assailant.
Lin Yi had investigated the area where Shangguan Jun had died. There were traces of an explosion, indicating Shangguan Jun had used explosives or a Hand Grenade.
Lin Yi had probed Jing Shu’s grandmother indirectly. Although the old lady had been reluctant to talk,
there was nothing that he, Lin Yi, couldn’t learn.
That day, there had been an explosion, and she had heard a bombing sound that made her vehicle overturn. She heard that repairing the vehicle later cost a lot of money and wasted plenty of food.
This made him even more curious.
Did this woman truly possess some mysterious power? No! There were no mysterious forces in the world; everything had a principle that could explain it, just like his ability.
What was the reason, after all?
"What a pity. This time I barely saw anything, wasting such a good opportunity." Lin Yi shook his head, glanced at the time, and his lips slowly curled up. "Well, it’s almost time for the show to begin, time for you to go out and play your roles as pawns."
"But before that, to make the act complete, you also need to experience something. It will make you more convincing when you get out. So, let’s give you a surprise on the surface."
Lin Yi’s slender fingers tapped out commands. Compared to Shangguan Jun, he was more adept at orchestrating from the shadows. He enjoyed the title people had given him: the behind-the-scenes big boss.
As the Enter key was struck, Lin Yi picked up his tea and took a sip before looking at the recording again. His upturned lips, however, gradually stiffened.
"Something is not quite right. Jing Shu’s behavior... it’s too calm, as if everything is under her control. Hmm? Now this is getting interesting. I hope what follows won’t disappoint me; it wouldn’t be fun if it were that easy to catch you."
「...」
After obtaining the Key, Su Malie successfully unlocked the chains binding them. Just like that, the two of them were released from the pillars they were tied to. They had finally regained their freedom!
"So, what exactly does Lin Yi want? He deliberately set up surveillance to watch us, as if... as if he wanted to see us try to escape? What’s his purpose in doing this?"
Jing Shu couldn’t help but feel suspicious of Lin Yi’s behavior.
Could he be like a cat playing with a mouse, repeatedly capturing and releasing it, just to revel in the thrill of the chase?
No... It couldn’t be that simple.
"Jing Shu, hurry! We can escape now! Let’s quickly get out of here. Regrettably, my phone and all my communication supplies have been confiscated. Never mind, we’ll figure something out once we’ve escaped," Su Malie urged, tugging at Jing Shu, no longer caring about her own bruised and battered appearance. This was the first time the young lady had suffered such a setback in her life.
Look, Su Malie is still so naive. Idiot. Someone is letting you go on purpose.
"Yes, let’s go."
Jing Shu straightened her clothes and wiped the dried blood from her face. She still had multiple scrapes that had now scabbed over. This was undoubtedly the most disheveled she had been since her rebirth.
Before leaving, Jing Shu ruthlessly kicked the already dead Fatty twice.
That jerk! He kicked me while my Magic Cube Space was upgrading and even tried to take advantage of me! Of course, I’m not one to hold grudges...
As she delivered a few more discreet kicks, she also took the opportunity to collect some insects from the ground and put them into her space.
Ahem, that’s right. I plan to breed some of these fierce insects, either as food for snakes and leeches or for future surprise attacks on people, disposing of bodies in the process. In any case, I’ll raise them for a while to see if they have any other special uses. I’m very eager to see how ferocious insects that drink spiritual spring water could become. I wonder if I could raise an army of insects that doesn’t require feeding, that could sustain itself on dead bodies, and could even be sold as food at critical moments...
Su Malie grabbed Jing Shu with both hands and pulled her away. Staring at the insects on the ground that had started to consume the body, and at the horrifically mangled corpses, Su Malie couldn’t help but tremble. "Let’s hurry! Wait, that Fatty has the watch I gave to Wang Chuan on his wrist! I need to take it as a keepsake. After all, Wang Chuan died trying to save us, and Da Mao took bullets for us. I’ll take care of their relatives, Ermao and Sanmao."
Overcoming her fear, Su Malie removed the watch and quickly ran off, pulling Jing Shu with her.
When they reached the door, Jing Shu stopped. They had two paths to choose from: the first led directly to the surface, and the second was an underground passage.
As expected, Su Malie wanted to head to the surface.
But Jing Shu pointed to the underground passage. "Let’s go this way."
After the upgrade of her Magic Cube Space, Jing Shu had become unprecedentedly powerful. She felt as if her Magic Cube Space had transformed from a peashooter to a cannon—a qualitative leap.
If my Magic Cube Space hadn’t been upgrading then, making me dazed, Wang Chuan wouldn’t have died. I had many ways to deal with that rapidly moving elevator.
Therefore, compared to following Lin Yi’s intentional guidance to the surface, Jing Shu felt that the underground passage was safer.
Besides, in the narrow confines of an underground passage, I have the ability to protect myself. On the surface, there are too many external factors to consider. If a group suddenly appeared and aimed guns at me, I would have no way to defend myself.
"But-but that’s how Wang Chuan died! It’s very dangerous down there," Su Malie said pitifully.
"I suspect this passage leads directly to Qian Duoduo’s house," Jing Shu said, her eyes narrowing.

chapters.title: Chapter 263: Do you believe I can blow up your West Mountain?
chapters.content:
Chapter 263: Do you believe I can blow up your West Mountain?
"Hmm? Why do you say it leads directly to Qian Duoduo’s house? Isn’t this Qian Duoduo’s estate we’re in?" Su Malie was confused.
Jing Shu shook her head. "I doubt Qian Duoduo knows anything about this. I think the man pretending to be your Uncle Gou, Lin Yi, did it on purpose. He took advantage of the road closure at West Mountain to make a long detour, entering from behind West Mountain and deliberately passing through Qian Duoduo’s estate."
"And then?" Su Malie blinked, trying to see the connection.
"To ensure your tracking data last registered at Qian Duoduo’s house. What do you think your father would do after you disappeared, with your last known location being on Qian Duoduo’s territory?" Jing Shu rolled her eyes.
Su Malie’s mouth fell open. "My father might desperately fight Qian Duoduo. But if Qian Duoduo doesn’t know about this, he’ll think my father is causing trouble for no reason, and they might end up fighting."
"People in their positions shouldn’t be so impulsive, right?" Jing Shu touched her nose.
People with great power and high status should be more composed, shouldn’t they?
Touching her head in distress, Su Malie explained, "You don’t know. Every time I’m kidnapped, my father goes insane and loses all reason! This is terrible! We absolutely have to take the route above ground and quickly let my father know we’re safe. Otherwise, he really might turn West Mountain upside down!"
Jing Shu frowned.
So, Lin Yi must have known all these key points, all these mind games he played, right? Did he do all this just to drive a wedge between Wu City’s top two tycoons and make them fight? It’s not that simple.
"That’s why we have to take the underground passage. It’s called taking the unexpected route; no one would think we’d go underground. Do you know how many of their accomplices are waiting for you up there? And are you sure you want to be devoured by red earthworms during a torrential downpour?"
Su Malie shook her head vigorously.
"Alright then, let’s hurry. There won’t be any issues this time, trust me." Jing Shu grabbed Su Malie, and they ran towards the underground passage.
They returned to the entrance from which they had made their thrilling escape from the elevator earlier. It was the same way they had come in.
The pebbles on the ground were still there. The pusher mechanism that had crushed Wang Chuan had been repaired by Fatty and his men. As for the body, who knew where Fatty had disposed of it.
Jing Shu searched for a long time for an ’elevator button’ to activate the new pusher mechanism, but unfortunately, she couldn’t find it. She realized the switch for this enormous passage was likely controlled only by Lin Yi; no one else would have the authority.
"Let’s go." Jing Shu climbed in, pulling Su Malie up after her. Su Malie reluctantly agreed.
She really didn’t want to take the underground passage, but Jing Shu was just so assertive. Whenever she was with Jing Shu, she couldn’t help but meekly obey. How pathetic of me... *whimper*...
Jing Shu moved quickly, constantly marking their location and the distance covered on the map on her phone, which she accessed within her dimensional space. She didn’t know how deep the passage ran, as there was no signal and GPS was unavailable.
"I’m hungry," Su Malie’s stomach growled. She bit her lower lip, her voice pitiful. She was also very cold; the temperature in the underground passage was low.
Jing Shu had been hungry ever since she woke up. After a moment’s thought, she took a compressed biscuit from a pocket in her close-fitting pants and gave it to Su Malie. "Chew it twenty-eight times before swallowing."
Su Malie nodded and gently bit off a piece, starting to chew.
My goodness, what is this? It’s so delicious!
Like a contented little hamster, Su Malie munched on the compressed biscuit.
With something to eat, Su Malie indeed quickened her pace. Jing Shu, however, wasn’t just eating compressed biscuits; she was enjoying chocolates, pistachios, nuts, and other snacks. Since the food materialized directly in her mouth thanks to her ability, she didn’t even need to visibly eat, so Su Malie had no idea what she was consuming.
Three kilometers covered.
Now four kilometers.
At first, there were some side tunnels, and they even passed the point where they had entered. Gradually, however, the forks disappeared, leaving only a straight underground passage. The tunnel was crudely dug, clearly not Qian Duoduo’s handiwork; it looked more like a cargo transport route.
Those poor rich people, having their estate undermined by a tunnel without even knowing! Someone’s clearly plotting something big.
Were all those side passages we just passed sealed off? Is Lin Yi trying to lead us to the end point?
It was now 3:00 p.m., four to five hours since Su Malie had disappeared.
Who knows what the situation outside is like now?
Jing Shu felt a headache coming on and couldn’t help but quicken her pace.
「...」
Lin Yi stood before a large screen, watching the activity on a nine-panel display. "So, they took the underground passage?" he mused, a slight smile playing on his lips. "In that case, let’s proceed with Plan B."
"Ling Qi, you can start now."
"Understood, boss."
「...」
The daughter of the Wu City natural gas CEO had been placed under house arrest by Wu City’s wealthiest man, Qian Duoduo, due to his peculiar tastes!
This news spread like wildfire, quickly causing an uproar. Even more alarmingly, Su Xiangnan, the natural gas CEO, had reportedly arrived at West Mountain with thousands of gas canisters, vowing to take that old scoundrel Qian Duoduo down with him!
The origin of the news was unknown, but it reached the upper echelons of Wu City within moments. Recognizing the gravity of the situation, the government immediately dispatched Wu City’s First Detachment—a special forces unit—along with the fire department to provide support. The Second Team, led by Li Yuetian, was also assembled and placed on standby, ready to deploy at a moment’s notice.
In just a few hours, thousands of people had swarmed West Mountain. It was the largest gathering of people there since the period a few months ago when many sought refuge from the torrential rains.
Upon hearing the news, Qian Duoduo’s first reaction was to wonder,
What game is that Old Ghost playing this time? Hasn’t he had enough of his tricks from last time?
Su Xiangnan had indeed played a nasty trick on him before.
This recalled the existing conflict of interest between them. Su Xiangnan, head of a local, multi-generational natural gas dynasty, had seen his family’s resources requisitioned by the government at low prices. Qian Duoduo, on the other hand, was an outsider, a nouveau riche who, with backing from Imperial Capital, had gained control of Wu City’s oil extraction and become the city’s wealthiest man in just two decades.
Su Xiangnan accused Qian Duoduo of enriching himself under the guise of state-owned enterprises. Qian Duoduo, in turn, accused Su Xiangnan of monopolizing national resources.
The two could not stand the sight of each other.
However, with the government backing Qian Duoduo, Su Xiangnan had ultimately suffered considerable disadvantages.
"Let’s discuss this calmly, Brother Su. Disagreements shouldn’t involve family; these aren’t matters to joke about. I genuinely haven’t seen your daughter. Could there be some misunderstanding?" Qian Duoduo, dressed in a Tang suit and leisurely twirling walnuts in his hand, said with composure. He thought,
His daughter is missing? What does that have to do with me?
Su Xiangnan’s already grim expression darkened further. He stood with his hands on his hips, pointing at Qian Duoduo. "Do you think I’m joking? Do you believe I won’t blow up your entire West Mountain? You think I can’t make one call and have an explosion go off out there right now?"
Just then... BANG!

chapters.title: Chapter 264: Jing Shu is the Mole?
chapters.content:
Chapter 264: Jing Shu is the Mole?
A tremendous crash resounded, and the entire villa shuddered. Qian Duoduo’s walnuts scattered across the floor, only to be trodden on several times.
Qian Duoduo could no longer maintain his composure. He scrambled on the floor to retrieve the walnuts he had been polishing for many years, getting stepped on a few more times in the process.
When everyone recovered from the chaos, they began to exclaim. Something outside had exploded, flames erupting into the sky even through the rain. It went without saying that the gas cylinders brought by Su Xiangnan must have detonated. This might have been just an appetizer; if he had really brought thousands of gas cylinders, they could probably blow West Mountain to smithereens!
Moreover, the explosion hadn’t occurred inside the villa; otherwise, everyone would likely have been done for.
Qian Duoduo gritted his teeth. "Su Madman, are you actually serious?!"
A flicker of surprise crossed Su Xiangnan’s gloomy face, but he quickly regained his composure, speaking through clenched teeth. "I, Mr. Su, have only this one precious daughter. If anything happens to her, I wouldn’t be able to face her mother in heaven, even in death. I’m not joking with you. Is my daughter’s disappearance related to you or not?"
After carefully putting his walnuts away, Qian Duoduo pondered for a moment.
Has Su Madman’s daughter really been kidnapped?
he wondered. He spoke in a low voice, "Are you sure you’re not being manipulated? I genuinely know nothing about this. Why don’t you tell me what happened?"
Su Xiangnan waved his hand, and the old butler stepped forward, nodding. "Alright, Sir. Today, the Young Miss set out for West Mountain with Ah Gou, two bodyguards, and her classmate Jing Shu. This was her planned route. She last stayed in your territory for over an hour, which means they still had a signal at that time."
"Moreover, the GPS signal from the Young Miss’s car also completely disappeared around that time."
"Here are all the Young Miss’s chat records and data from the past few days, including surveillance of her chats with Ah Gou, her bodyguards, and her classmate Jing Shu. This confirms who was privy to her plans; there’s no indication the information was leaked beyond this circle."
"It was your man, Fatty, who was supposed to be collecting materials for you. He invited her over this morning to inspect goods and discuss business. She disappeared between 10:30 and 11:00 AM. I initially suspected that someone else was using your name to collect materials and had secretly kidnapped our Young Miss to frame you, thereby sowing discord between our families."
At this point in the old butler’s explanation, Qian Duoduo nodded. He, too, had feared such a deliberate act.
"However, I’ve verified the ID and IP address Fatty used. The person who invited the Young Miss was indeed one of yours. And they did conduct business with our Young Miss, with oil as compensation, correct?"
Qian Duoduo frowned. "Wait a second. Fatty is indeed my man. He came with me from the mainland and is trustworthy. I’ll call him over to verify. Go, get Fatty. Tell him to bring all the records from this morning’s transaction."
Someone went to fetch him.
The guest villa fell silent, and the atmosphere grew heavy. Soon, Fatty hurried in with his men.
"Boss, you called for me? I’ve brought all the documents and items. Is something wrong?" Fatty asked, wiping sweat from his face.
Qian Duoduo waved his hand. "Tell everyone about the transaction you handled this morning and the people involved."
"Oh, alright. Yesterday, I arranged with Su Malie to inspect the goods today. Su Malie arrived on time this morning, and we completed the transaction as agreed. Look, these are all the goods she brought, and this is the contract we signed. We agreed on three shipments of Blood Mushrooms, for which I paid a total of 20 tons of oil. Afterward, the man she calls Uncle Gou drove the oil away, and our transaction was concluded."
Su Xiangnan gestured with his eyes, and the old butler went up to inspect the items, then nodded. "These are indeed the Young Lady’s goods."
After examining the goods, the old butler showed photos on his phone to Fatty. "Look carefully. This person in the photo is Su Malie. This one is called Uncle Gou. These two are her bodyguards, and this one is her classmate, Jing Shu. There were supposed to be five people in total for this transaction with you."
After a careful look, Fatty said, "The one she called Uncle Gou is indeed this person, and Su Malie is correct too. But the two bodyguards were wearing those kinds of hats, so I couldn’t see their faces clearly. As for her classmate you mentioned... there were only four people at the transaction!"
The old butler and Su Xiangnan exchanged a glance.
The old butler asked again, "Are you sure this Jing Shu wasn’t there? Or perhaps she waited at the entrance and didn’t come in?"
Fatty nodded. "I’m certain. There were only four people. They even arrived in a custom-built luxury van, and I personally went to greet them."
"That can’t be right," Su Xiangnai frowned deeply. "What time did they leave? And where did they go?"
Fatty scratched his head. "I don’t know about that. The man called Uncle Gou drove off with the oil. Su Malie waited there with the two bodyguards. After that, we all left."
The old butler looked at Su Xiangnan and nodded. "According to Jing Shu’s file, she was definitely with the Young Lady when she left. So, either their people are lying, or this Jing Shu is an insider."
Qian Duoduo remained silent for a long moment before speaking. "I know that girl, Jing Shu. I’ve done business with her several times, and our collaborations were always smooth. As for Fatty, he has no reason to lie. I can show you all his recent data. I believe there must be some misunderstanding here."
"Sir, sir! We’ve found the Young Lady’s car! It’s right where the GPS signal disappeared. It hasn’t been moved!"
Su Xiangnan’s fists clenched tightly. He asked in a chilling tone, "And you still claim this has nothing to do with you? The car wasn’t moved an inch! They disappeared right here, on your territory!"
A bead of sweat trickled down Qian Duoduo’s cheek.
Is someone really trying to frame me? Who could it be?
Two possibilities instantly surfaced in Qian Duoduo’s mind: One, someone was genuinely trying to frame him, but this attempt was too clumsy. Two, Su Xiangnan had orchestrated this whole charade to gain his trust before betraying him.
"Don’t worry, calm down," Qian Duoduo said. "I’ll immediately pull up all the West Mountain surveillance footage for you. As long as they entered West Mountain, I have them on camera. If they want to leave West Mountain, they couldn’t, even if they sprouted wings. I have helicopters patrolling the sky, and there’s only one road out. It’s highly probable they’re still on West Mountain."
Qian Duoduo had to clear his name.
"Then dig! Dig three feet deep if you have to, but find her for me! Go! Start searching from the exact spot where the Young Lady disappeared. Don’t miss a single corner, especially any place with hidden rooms or basements!" Su Xiangnan ordered grimly.
I understand everything Qian Duoduo is saying. It’s all just to clear his own name. How could someone infiltrate his territory without him knowing a thing? Ridiculous! What an act.
"Sir, sir! We’ve found an underground casino where the Young Lady disappeared!"

chapters.title: Chapter 265: Ensure the Entire West Mountain is Blown Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 265: Ensure the Entire West Mountain is Blown Up
This news shocked everyone present!
"Go, turn the underground casino upside down to see if there are any traces of Miss," Su Xiangnan said coldly, showing a chilling smile at Qian Duoduo. "I didn’t expect Mr. Qian to have such varied interests."
Somehow, he was reminded of Jing Shu again.
"How is it? Any response from the Banana District? Where is Jing Shu?"
The old butler shook his head. "She should indeed be with Miss."
Su Xiangnan then fell silent.
Perhaps this incident was inevitably linked to Jing Shu. Perhaps she was also a victim. After all, according to the chat logs, it was his daughter who initiated the contact, and Fatty, who initiated contact with his daughter, was the primary suspect.
Mr. Qian showed an awkward yet polite smile. "Something built in my youth; it has long been in ruins."
The atmosphere in the hall grew increasingly tense. Qian Duoduo occasionally listened to reports from his subordinates, his eyelids beginning to twitch.
Things looked grim.
He waved his hand, whispering to Wu Fu, "Send Qian Shengqian, Qian Qianjin, and Madam to the castle. Ensure their safety and activate the castle’s air-raid mode.
It seems these people really want to blow up my West Mountain.
Also, ask when the government’s support will arrive. Send someone to arrange it, and make sure these madmen don’t actually blow up the gas tanks."
"Yes, I’ll go now."
「Sometime later」
"Master, Miss has been found!"
Su Xiangnan abruptly stood up.
The man, panting heavily, said, "We found Miss’s belongings. She was indeed in a secret room in the casino under the dilapidated manor. After we pried open the locked door of the secret room, we discovered traces of her having been there."
"Where is Miss? And everyone else!"
"The floor tiles in the secret room were pried open, connecting to an underground tunnel. It seems Miss might have escaped with others. From the scene, it was clear she was indeed confined there. There was no signal inside. Our people have already gone to search the underground tunnel, but it seems very extensive."
SMASH! The chair was violently thrown to the ground. People from both sides quietly drew their weapons, while Su Xiangnan’s men even raised gas tanks.
Qian Duoduo exclaimed, "Put down your weapons! Do you all want to die?!"
"Mr. Qian, perhaps you could explain my daughter’s confinement. You still claim you didn’t do it? Where is she?!"
Qian Duoduo frowned deeply. "Brother Su, the manor casino was indeed built more than a decade ago, and the underground tunnel was also constructed then, but it was all a whim. That area has been untouched for a long time; I even had it sealed off. Liu Fu, go get the map of the underground tunnel for Brother Su’s men. It will help them avoid getting lost. Perhaps Brother Su’s daughter is still in there."
Qian Duoduo tapped the table. "Also, I’m curious how your daughter ended up locked in the manor’s underground casino. That place has been deserted for many years. Brother Su, there’s something fishy about this. Wu Fu, go pull up all entry and surveillance records from West Mountain for the past half month. By the way, Fatty, did Su Malie ever go to the underground casino at the manor?"
"I don’t know, Boss. Our deal was completed at your conference venue, and I left right after. Here’s my activity map for today; I really didn’t have time to go to a distant place like Ruins Manor to confine Su Malie." Fatty was near collapse.
How could a straightforward business deal stir up so much trouble?
Liu Fu brought out the blueprint. "This is the underground tunnel Mr. Qian built years ago, but construction was halted long ago for various reasons. Currently, less than two kilometers of tunnel have been built around the casino, including a control room and six underground storages. However, this tunnel has been sealed for a long time. Miss Su could easily get lost in these places."
If Jing Shu were here, she would have realized. She had been wondering why there were so many forks at the beginning, but later it turned into a straight path. The workmanship was also very poor, obviously not Qian Duoduo’s handiwork.
Su Xiangnan’s face was grim, and he remained silent.
He knew his daughter was exceptionally lucky, but every time she was kidnapped, he still felt a sinking feeling of dread. In previous instances, the kidnappers had demanded money, which he could handle, but this time, he could not be sure. He was even unsure whether Qian Duoduo wanted to harm his daughter to make his natural gas company concede, or if someone was truly framing Qian Duoduo, and for what purpose. Up until now, he still didn’t know who was trying to harm his daughter, and that was the most terrifying part.
"Send all our people in. Make sure to search every corner."
「Elsewhere」
"Boss, Su Xiangnan’s people have entered the underground tunnel. Requesting permission to close the main passage and open the auxiliary passage."
"Request acknowledged."
"Boss, the plan is complete. Qian Duoduo’s fortress air defense channel is open."
Light glinted off Lin Yi’s glasses. "Very well. The turtle shell has finally cracked. Fill it with explosives. Also, double-check the explosives placed elsewhere. We must ensure we can blow up the entire West Mountain."
"Understood, Boss."
「Back in the hall」
As time ticked by, everyone grew increasingly restless. Qian Duoduo began to check various entry records and surveillance footage. Uncle Gou’s image appeared in many of the feeds.
Qian Duoduo pointed at Uncle Gou’s image on the screen. "Brother Su, it seems you might have a mole?"
Su Xiangnan’s expression flickered. "Then who is this woman who often enters and exits with him? Is she one of your people?"
Qian Duoduo’s expression also stiffened.
Has someone indeed infiltrated? Or is this Su Xiangnan’s doing? What exactly are they planning?
He looked suspiciously at Su Xiangnan.
Is this whole drama not orchestrated by Su Xiangnan himself?
Some matters, simple at heart, become complicated when overthought by complex minds.
Both men had already envisioned dozens of possibilities.
"Master, we’ve searched everywhere, but still nothing! Miss disappeared completely after descending from the secret room into the tunnel."
"Impossible!" Qian Duoduo was the first to frown. "The tunnel is a dead end. If she indeed reached it, how could there be no trace?"
"Then you tell me, Mr. Qian! Where have you hidden her? Don’t think I really wouldn’t dare blow up your West Mountain!" Su Xiangnan had lost his patience.
No sooner had he finished speaking than the outside erupted with BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! The entire mountain quaked. The previous blast seemed like a mere drizzle in comparison. These explosions were deafening, and the entire villa shook violently!
Through the window, Qian Duoduo heard the sounds from outside.
He had no idea how many places had been blown up. His heart was bleeding.
Dust filled the air, and the rumbling continued. After a moment, Qian Duoduo, teeth clenched, snarled, "Su Xiangnan, I’ve tolerated you for long enough! Stop this right now! Do you have any idea of the consequences?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 266: I’m Going to Find Explosives (Second Update)
chapters.content:
Chapter 266: I’m Going to Find Explosives (Second Update)
Qian Duoduo, dressed in a Tang suit, also looked disheveled at this moment, his face smeared with dust from the collapsed villa. Despite this, he was still urgently making arrangements, "Bafu, tally up what was bombed, assess the current situation, and check for any casualties! Then, send some people to check on the castle!"
Owning an estate that spanned the entire mountain had its downsides—it was simply too large. Whenever an incident occurred, someone had to be dispatched to take inventory. The young man named Bafu held a device that continuously displayed records and feedback information as the more than six hundred people on West Mountain began to operate at high speed.
Su Xiangnan furrowed his brow, realizing something was amiss.
