I’ll just detour to stroll around Yangcheng (Guangzhou), Foshan, Shunde, Chaoshan, those places that always make people drool... then accidentally buy a house full of food and various fruit trees, along with lots of local specialties, sounds reasonable, right?"
It’s too reasonable, simply perfect.
By the way, why is Guangzhou called Yangcheng? Is it because everyone in this city speaks like "baaabaaaz"?
"The first time going, I wonder if bringing fifty million Virtual Coins is enough?..."
Jing Shu felt just like the first time she went to Starbucks, worried about not bringing enough money.
"But usually, precious supplies are bartered, so I’d better bring more Blood Mushrooms, ginseng, and Ganoderma, hmm, bring more of those overabundant live snakes and Bees too, heard the snake soup here is especially delicious. Oh, and bring out a few cows, I heard the beef balls in Chaoshan hot pot are super tasty."
"Oh, and the rooms full of liquor from the United States could also be exchanged for some good stuff, right?"
"And that horribly nasty, moldy cheese should quickly be traded out too..."
After busying for quite a while, Master Jing managed to sort out several Hulk-sized carriage loads of idle supplies from the warehouse and space. On the opening day of the cigarette factory and mask factory, she hurriedly served as the fake smiling tool for the grand opening’s ribbon-cutting ceremony, and after the cameraman gave an OK gesture, she boarded the Blue Moon ferry with her Hulk bodyguards to fetch cargo from Xuwen Pier.
The Blue Moon made thud-thud sounds, the burning rotten corpse insects smell permeated the ship’s cabin, the black seawater emitted a fishy odor, and the rotten mermaids swam freely in the sea, silently following the ferry. After a bumpy one-hour journey, Jing Shu arrived at Xuwen Pier.
After the Blue Moon took two months’ worth of raw material cargo, it returned to South Sea. Jing Shu, having traveled a long way from Sichuan, met six factory transportation teams along the way, and they continued their sea route toward Guangshen. Next, they still have to head to Fujian, Zhejiang, Modu, and other places to deliver cigarette factory raw materials.
"General Manager Jing, you go rest in the VIP cabin upstairs; we’ll take care of things here, and tomorrow when we reach the place, I’ll take you for a stroll around Yangcheng." said Zhang Yicheng, responsible for this transport to Yangcheng, in a flattering Guang dialect.
A heavenly ancestor came to inspect work, Zhang Yicheng wasn’t troubled at all, but instead felt Jing Shu was his benefactor.
Whether the end-of-year rating can rise depends on how many points President Jing gives him.
"No need, I’ll just have a look; how come I haven’t seen our escort masters?" Jing Shu asked.
It’s worth mentioning since the raw materials are extremely valuable and there’s a fear of being robbed, plus they themselves belong to ultra-dangerous goods, and if a few Ticks pop out, they’d suck people dry.
So in addition to ordinary transport personnel, they also hired two special line professional bodyguards at a high price to escort, which in ancient times would be considered hiring an escort team, right?
"Oh, them, under normal circumstances, they don’t come out. They only come out to solve problems when the goods are in danger." Zhang Yicheng said mysteriously.
"Alright then, you all go ahead."
"Ah, yes, yes, be careful of the wet floor, I’ll go to the deck to verify the process with the captain." Zhang Yicheng rolled up his wet pant legs and hurried away.
"Alright."
Jing Shu then took two Hulk bodyguards for a casual look around, releasing some insects to patrol, mainly to eliminate lurking dangers, which was also her occupational habit out of being timid and afraid to die.
As trucks sealed with mugwort and beeswax boarded the ferry, coffins on trucks boarded as well.
On the way, when reaching places with steep slopes, from the coffins, unexpectedly hopped out... pale, bloodless people looking like corpses, helping to push the trucks uphill.
Strangely, these people not like the living, eh, after pushing the trucks, jumped back into the coffins and even closed the coffin lids themselves.
Everything returned to tranquility.
Jing Shu: "???"
Jing Shu tilted her head, her mouth’s crispy, fried dried fish dropped without her knowing, pondering whether she was in the wrong script?
The dried fish fell to the ground, picked up by a pale hand, revealing black eyes without whites and crimson lips, kindly reminding: "You dropped your fish..."
"Boom!" A loud noise.
That red-lipped, white-teethed frail young man was kicked flying a dozen meters, then embedded firmly into the ferry’s iron plate.
"What the heck? Was that a person? Could even talk?" Jing Shu really got spooked just now and couldn’t help but... just...
The loud noise alarmed Zhang Yicheng on the deck, scaring him out of his wits.
"What happened??"
"What’s wrong, President Jing? Are you okay?? Oh, my ancestor..." My bonus, my promotion!
Eh...? President Jing is calmly standing there.
"That’s good, that’s good!" Zhang Yicheng patted his chest; his rice bowl, his bonus was safe.
Suddenly, there was another voice.
"Excuse me, could Team Leader Zhang help pull me out?"

chapters.title: Chapter 799 - 889: Xiangxi Corpse Chaser??
chapters.content:
Chapter 799: Chapter 889: Xiangxi Corpse Chaser??
It turned out to be the young man embedded in the iron plate frame who was speaking.
"Huh? Is that Situ Xiaoye? Could he have been plastered into the wall? Hey, is there anyone in this world who can slam you into a wall..." Zhang Yicheng ran over, huffing and puffing, and pulled the young man out.
The young man twisted his neck, showing no sign of injury whatsoever.
Jing Shu sensed something was off—could this guy be one of us?
Zhang Yicheng introduced the mud-covered Situ Xiaoye to Jing Shu:
"Ah, President Jing, this is our security team’s captain, Situ Xiaoye." He then turned his head and said, "Xiao Ye, this is our Cigarette Factory’s Big Boss, Miss Jing."
Jing Shu felt incredibly embarrassed, quickly saying, "Are you okay? I’m sorry, I thought—thought you were a zombie just now... one unrestrained motion and I lightly kicked..."
"What?! So the noise earlier was from President Jing accidentally, lightly kicking Xiao Ye flying? President Jing, your strength is immense!" Zhang Yicheng swallowed hard, covering his mouth in shock after learning the truth. Who would’ve thought that President Jing, seemingly delicate like a flower, was so badass?
Goodness, what kind of strength does it take to kick someone like Xiao Ye into a wall? President Jing is terrifying.
"Hehe, it’s just a tad stronger than an average person," Jing Shu said modestly.
"Hehe," thought Zhang Yicheng skeptically.
"Well, you all carry on chatting."
Since the misunderstanding was resolved and most importantly, Boss Jing was unharmed, Zhang Yicheng went back to his tasks on deck, and the ferry began its journey with a hum.
It was said that they would arrive at Yangcheng’s dock in twelve hours and could catch the myriad varieties of morning tea there.
Jing Shu couldn’t help but look forward to it.
"It’s nothing, nothing. I startled Miss Jing. Miss Jing, if you don’t want the fish, can you give it to me?" Situ Xiaoye, with eyes as dark as a cave, asked, showing a dirty little dried fish in his hand.
"I don’t want it, don’t want it. Here, take all of it,"
Jing Shu felt quite embarrassed, quickly handing over a bag of crispy fried little dried fish.
Situ Xiaoye waved his hand quickly, saying one piece was enough since it was mainly for his pet little flower cat to satisfy its cravings.
"What a coincidence, you have a pet too? Then take all of this and let your little flower cat have a feast."
"My little flower cat has a huge appetite, so just a little taste will do. Miss Jing, you’re giving too much, it would be wasteful."
"What a coincidence, my pet also has a big appetite. I understand, so let me give you two more smoked fish! It’s the least I could do after accidentally kicking you."
Who can refuse the happiness brought by dried fish and smoked fish? So Situ Xiaoye accepted them and simultaneously handed Jing Shu a ring that looked like it was woven from dog grass tails.
"This is a ring woven from a special poisonous insect corpse. When you wear it, if you get poisoned, it will shatter once it’s absorbed enough toxins."
It’s basically a one-time detoxification tool.
Jing Shu put on the ring.
Within three seconds, with a "crack," the ring shattered.
The atmosphere became slightly awkward.
Situ Xiaoye took out another one, tested it on himself, and then handed it to Jing Shu, "Maybe it’s expired, here, this one is new."
Jing Shu took the ring and put it on, "crack," and it shattered again.
Jing Shu: "..." Hmm, does she have poison on her?
Situ Xiaoye: "..." Miss Jing must have a big secret!
Situ Xiaoye took out a small packet: "This is sluggish petrification powder. It’s useful for any creature; just scatter it when needed. Hope it helps."
Alright, better accept it and move on from this topic.
With this, the two of them became more familiar with each other, and their conversation became much more casual.
Jing Shu also learned that Situ Xiaoye was considered a person. According to the new laws of the apocalypse, regarding New Humans, as long as you’re conscious and willing to abide by the law, it doesn’t matter what form your body takes—you’re a good child of the motherland, a New Human of the motherland.
At most, Situ Xiaoye was a New Human, not a zombie, so Jing Shu finally voiced her doubts.
"Xiao Ye, earlier I saw everyone jumping in and out of coffins... I was so shocked that I thought I saw zombies, especially since I’ve recently met a friend, so I wondered if I was witnessing the scene of a corpse chaser with zombies."
Actually, Jing Shu was panicking inside earlier, but she wouldn’t say it.
Situ Xiaoye, with his pupils devoid of whites, said:
"You’re right, but I am the zombie being chased by the legendary corpse chaser."
"Ha??"
How can you be so unexpected?? Damn it, I guessed wrong!
Then she heard Xiao Ye narrate the tale:
"That year, when our entire village was about to starve, we discovered an edible black plant in the mountains. Not only did we survive, but every one of us also gained immense strength...
However, good things didn’t last long. A few months later, we gradually lost our sense of pain, our bodies became rigid, skin pallid, the whites of our eyes vanished, and our vision was severely impaired. The final result was that more and more villagers became as hard as stone and eventually turned into immobile corpses, like zombies."
"And then?" Jing Shu raised an eyebrow, looking Xiao Ye up and down—don’t get it wrong, not in that way. No, it’s Boss Jing pondering if this zombie thing could be even more formidable with her rotten mermaid tetanus-A package, adding a petrification effect. Could be a business opportunity to explore later.
"Just when I thought those transformed into zombie corpses were dead, they indeed were."
Jing Shu: "..." Thank you, the last time I was this speechless was the last time.
"By that time, only one friend of mine in the entire village hadn’t died, because back then he was the only one who ate that plant and underwent no change, just remained an ordinary person with unchanged strength. I remember laughing at him, saying he must have wronged others, otherwise, why did everyone else become superhumans while he showed no reaction?
Anyway, when the villagers’ bodies became stone-like corpses, there was no point for my friend to stay any longer. So, he spat a mouthful of saliva at the body he once mocked—oh, which was my body—and was about to leave when I unexpectedly revived..."
Well, that’s bizarre enough.
"Afterward, although we all came back to life, our bodies remained stiff, requiring not only continuous consumption of that plant but also periodic dousing of bodily fluids from that friend of mine... Yes, any produced from him, whether upper or lower regions, but the white fluid worked even better."
Jing Shu quietly took a step back.
Situ Xiaoye coughed, "Miss Jing, are you thinking incorrectly? You must be! Actually, there are professionals who collect, extract, and dilute it in fixed proportions to make standard patches that enable movement. By the way, the probiotics you all consume contain hundreds of millions of bowel bacteria anyway."

chapters.title: Chapter 800 - 890: Early Morning Tea in Yangcheng?
chapters.content:
Chapter 800: Chapter 890: Early Morning Tea in Yangcheng?
With this explanation, Jing Shu made a sound of understanding, but the explanation was even more confusing. What does it mean to have someone dedicated to collecting?
Is it like what she imagined, having a cute girl assist in collecting? Is it done with an instrument or by hand? Jing Shu shook her head vigorously, tossing aside the wild thoughts.
"So, you don’t know, his body fluids are particularly valuable now, and many people are researching them."
Jing Shu nodded.
"So, as you can see, we have a certain level of strength. Ticks can’t penetrate our bodies, so the dangerous job of escorting ticks has been contracted out by people in our village. After all, the benefits you offer are too good. Everyone in the village is working hard to train, striving for a spot in the next escort mission."
Jing Shu showed an expression of naturalness: "Our factory’s benefits have always been the best. By the way, what’s your friend’s name? Why didn’t he come along?"
"He now claims to be a Xiangxi Corpse Chaser, and his current job is simply to drink more water every day, produce more fluids because our village has hundreds of people waiting for him to save them," Situ Xiaoye said, giving Jing Shu a sidelong glance with an expression that seemed to say ’See, you thought too much.’
"Ah, this is completely different from what I imagined a corpse chaser to be. Is this really what a corpse chaser does?
I thought they were powerful masters outside the mortal realm, holding a bell in one hand and a Taohua Sword in the other... Wait, my friend is also called Xiangxi Corpse Chaser! Look, is it this person?"
Jing Shu took out a WeChat profile picture of a man in a Taoist robe holding some kind of ceremonial tool looking very impressive.
The Xiangxi Corpse Chaser was indeed an active member of the loving bodyguard team, always seeming very leisurely and fond of boasting in the group chat. He would say the zombies he chased were amazing, some could dance ballet, some could tell jokes, some were Michelin-star chefs, and some had incredibly high combat power. In any case, they were all multi-talented.
From this perspective, he does seem very free.
Situ Xiaoye nodded: "That’s him." Then, looking at the group Jing Shu was in, he said, "So, Miss Jing is also going to the Middle East? We’re going there next month too."
So they were business friends going to restock together, just like family.
Jing Shu instantly looked at Situ Xiaoye with more warmth in her eyes.
"Then why aren’t you in the group?" These days, Jing Shu had become quite the family with the bodyguard team, so she was quite sure Situ Xiaoye’s lot wasn’t included.
"He says that as a corpse chaser, we are the chased corpses, so how could the corpses be in the bodyguard group? Actually, he’s just afraid we’ll catch him boasting every day."
Jing Shu nodded, indeed, very boastful, online users are really talented, and she found herself increasingly looking forward to the joint Middle Eastern journey ahead.
"Then see you next time, Xiao Ye, next time bring your little flower cat to meet my pet, maybe they’ll have common topics?"
Though Jing Shu didn’t know what topics a chicken and a cat could have, it was just polite chatter, just like saying ’let’s play together next time’.
Situ Xiaoye nodded: "Okay, Miss Jing, looking forward to next time." And with that, he lay into a coffin.
Situ Xiaoye was different from other stiff villagers, his body flexibility was like a normal person’s, with no stiffness at all. Maybe, it was because of his good relationship with the corpse chaser, who poured more water over him??
A night passed without words.
Early the next morning, the ferry safely arrived at Yangcheng Pier. Jing Shu, excited and unable to sleep all night, with dark circles under her eyes, muddled through unloading her goods, then hurriedly bid farewell to the people from the next transportation team.
Then she muddled her way onto the business car dispatched by the Yangcheng cigarette factory, with two rows of Hulks tightly sticking to the rear of the car, scaring the driver into shouting, "What the hell, do these monsters have a car!"
Zhang Yicheng calmed him down with a few words before the driver settled.
Jing Shu, yawning, asked, "Team Leader Zhang, are we heading back to the company first?"
Zhang Yicheng took out the itinerary and said, "It’s like this, President Jing, we’re going to do some business first..."
Jing Shu’s yawn stopped, Zhang Yicheng felt the air grow cold for a moment.
Zhang Yicheng immediately finished his sentence: "It’s customary here to have morning tea while doing business, it’s set at the five-star hotel Bai Tiane Jade Spring, but primarily President Wu will handle it, you just need to listen in and perhaps give a few pointers."
Having said that in one breath, Jing Shu’s yawn continued, and Zhang Yicheng felt the air warm up again.
Zhang Yicheng wiped a bit of sweat with a smile, "Now that General Manager Jing is here on our turf, we really need to treat you well. The higher-ups insist on the highest standard of dining and the best accommodation for you, it represents our cigarette factory’s reputation, please do not refuse!
At noon, visit our cigarette factory. With your experience, provide some guidance, point out any shortcomings and we’ll make adjustments immediately.
In the evening, there’s a welcome dinner arranged for you at Yangcheng Restaurant. In short, during your stay, don’t worry about anything, just enjoy our culinary culture and let me know if you need anything. I’m your guide these few days."
Though Zhang Yicheng spoke courteously, Jing Shu understood.
"Free meals and accommodations these days, with transportation included! Most importantly, have fun."
Who could refuse the joy of getting things for free?
No wonder the leaders love inspections; if it were Jing Shu, she would love it too!
Jing Shu nodded with satisfaction: "Then Team Leader Zhang, arrange as you see fit, but I also brought some local specialties, nothing extravagant, just some small tokens, later distribute a bit to everyone in the factory."
Although getting things for free was joyful, Jing Shu wasn’t one to truly take without giving anything, so she decided to rummage through her space for something suitable, things unused at home to give away.
"Ah... President Jing, although we’re a branch, our factory is quite large, with over 2,000 employees."
Jing Shu raised her head in thought and found suitable local specialties: "Oh, over 2,000 employees?"
Zhang Yicheng nodded: "Yes, quite a number..."
Before he could finish, Boss Jing interrupted: "Then the surplus can be rewards for the top-performing employees!"
"Eh?"
Zhang Yicheng was curious about what kind of local specialties, but didn’t ask. Perhaps they weren’t some rare specialties, otherwise wouldn’t 2,000 people eat the boss out of house and home?
...
The White Swan is the country’s first five-star hotel, merging the quaint garden scenery and modern understated luxury to the fullest. The babbling water of the fake mountain waterfall was refreshing, while the melodious and serene sound of the guzheng came from a pavilion by the ornamental pool, and Jing Shu saw slender fingers plucking the strings of the guzheng.
"This way, please."

chapters.title: Chapter 801 - 891: Damn, the Dim Sum in Yangcheng Is Just Too Delicious!
chapters.content:
Chapter 801: Chapter 891: Damn, the Dim Sum in Yangcheng Is Just Too Delicious!
In the private room, there were already five or six people seated. Zhang Yicheng enthusiastically introduced, "President Wu, all esteemed bosses, this is Miss Jing Shu, the big boss of several cigarette factories nationwide."
At this moment, a middle-aged man wearing slippers, big shorts, and a tank top got up to greet her: "Come, come, take your seat. President Jing, it’s your first time here, you must stay for a few days so we can properly show you our hospitality."
Zhang Yicheng then excused himself to the factory to check on the goods.
Afterward, the casually dressed Wu Jiang introduced Jing Shu to the others. Among them, two were leaders in the fishery industry, two were representatives from the grain industry, and one was a shareholder of this place. It could be said that this seemingly ordinary table was actually full of industry giants.
"President Jing, it’s the apocalypse now, and many cuisines are gone. There are only a hundred or so types of dim sum for breakfast now, so make do."
Is that even humanly possible?
A breakfast with over a hundred types, and you’re complaining it’s not enough??
Jing Shu returned a polite smile.
As they took their seats, someone specially brought out a sanitized hot towel to wipe their hands.
A young server specializing in brewing tea demonstrated washing the tea, brewing it, and finally served the tea.
Each person had their own little teapot in front of them.
Exquisite, truly exquisite.
Wu Jiang from the cigarette factory began to chat with the others while drinking tea, mainly discussing the current economy and government policies.
Jing Shu took a tentative sip, hmm, it was just the taste of tea, but given the ceremonial vibe, she pretended to savor it for a moment.
And then, the main event arrived.
Shortly after, two waiters pushed carts in. The small plates, stacked high and just the size of a palm, were today’s dim sum!
Everyone got a small portion, with very high standards.
Yangcheng fresh shrimp dumplings, two per plate, with a thin skin and hefty filling. The shrimp meat was fresh and sweet. One bite released the delicious juice and the firm, springy shrimp meat, immediately awakening Jing Shu’s taste buds.
Ginger egg slices, shaped like fried mahua, yet not hard when bitten, melt in your mouth. Besides the rich aroma of eggs, there was a slight ginger flavor, which was the highlight of the dish. Before she could savor another bite, it was gone.
The seemingly ordinary steamed custard buns with yellow filling exploded with flavor. The runny yolk mixed with the fluffy, soft bun drenched in sauce gave a mouthful of creamy goodness.
The custard tart, with its layers crumbling and melting in your mouth, featured a smooth, fragrant, and slightly sweet baked custard that was just right — any sweeter would be cloying, any less and it would lack flavor. It was perfectly balanced.
Not to mention the fall-off-the-bone chicken feet, sweet and savory char siu buns, crispy outside and tender inside flaky pastries, wife cakes that were better than having a wife, and smooth, jelly-like double skin milk... and so on.
And things Jing Shu had never even heard of, like Fresh Cream Mango Rolls, Salmon Mustard Spring Rolls, Abalone tart, Hundred Truffle Shumai...
With things like Whole Abalone Roasted Goose Crispy Red Sausage Rice Noodles, so many delicious ingredients, even if paired with a shoe sole, they’d be tasty. Wrapped in a translucent, fragrant, and glutinous rice flour skin, it offered a flavorful experience with layers that lingered long after the meal.
Saying there are only a hundred kinds of dim sum here is humble. There are dozens of ways to make rice noodles alone, just like Chinese Pancakes, you can add anything. It’s really incredible. Combine them with varieties of pork, beef, shrimp, chicken, and all kinds of shiitake mushrooms, green vegetables, and ham, and the different fillings paired with different sauces created an entirely new and wondrous taste.
The only downside is the small portions, just a bite of each variety. Just when you taste the delicious flavor, it’s gone, and the next item is already enticing you. Trapped in a loop of deliciousness and departures, it’s truly a torturous tease for your taste buds.
Fortunately, this feeling didn’t last long, as Jing Shu had finished all her portions cleanly. Finally, her stomach gurgled, and the others turned their attention to her. For a moment, the air was peculiarly silent.
"Ahem! I just heard Mr. Long from the fishery industry speaking. Last year, Yangcheng and other cities exchanged resources, introducing most domestic fish varieties. Although I have fewer varieties, the quality is quite good for breeding stock, so I’d like to exchange some resources with you, Mr. Long. If there are no fish you want to exchange, I also have various quality grain resources at the Township Government."
The quickest way to resolve awkwardness was to change the subject.
Sure enough, as soon as Jing Shu spoke, the attention of Mr. Long from the fishery industry and the person from the grain industry shifted toward her.
Mr. Long said, "As long as it’s a missing variety or a particularly excellent type of fish, we can certainly exchange it..."
But actually, Mr. Long didn’t think Jing Shu had anything of interest to him. After all, individual strength compared to a city is still too small.
Even if it’s an excellent fish species, how excellent could it be?
Could it be better than theirs?
Moreover, are there really crayfish as thick as an arm, abalone as big as a face, or crabs as large as a basketball in this world?
Subsequently, Mr. Long and Jing Shu exchanged some fish species, revealing a Versailles-like pride. Although Mr. Long exuded a strong "my aquatic products are number one in the world, my fish rule the universe best" aura, Jing Shu was genuinely dazzled.
Come on, introducing the species is enough, why did you have to mention the cooking methods? Even if you do, why describe the taste, making Jing Shu drool all the way down three thousand feet?
As everyone knows, some of Jing Shu’s live seafood varieties were sourced from the wholesale market in Wu City before the apocalypse, a place in the Northwest with no sea, limited to common fish, shrimp, crab, and abalone... about a few dozen kinds.
Later, while in the United States, on a wealthy person’s ship, she took many precious frozen seafood from their cold storage, like a ton of bluefin tuna and sturgeon caviar.
The live seafood she acquired included king crabs, Boston lobsters, sea cucumbers, and sea urchins - these high-grade items, but that’s about it.
While Mr. Long spoke of what Yangcheng had:
"For example, dragon tongue fish, with few bones and much flesh, delicious when pan-fried or stewed."
"Also, red seabream, palm-sized, with tender, tasty flesh, commonly eaten around here."
"Mackerel is high in fat and exceptionally delicious when cooked with ’snow cabbage.’ It also makes a great soup."
Mr. Long then said, of course, he had dozens of fish types, but as for crabs, there are flying crabs, red armored crabs, squid flower covers, and more than a dozen kinds, some perfect for raw marination.
And various kinds of shrimp, like nine-section shrimp, red shrimp, Lougu shrimp, Shrimp Monster, raw edible Arctic sweet shrimp, Peony Shrimp, and Red Demon Shrimp, Mao Shrimp for making shrimp paste, as well as a variety of shells and all kinds of conchs, amounting to about a hundred.
An array of varieties, a multitude of choices, truly living up to its reputation as a place where the nation’s fresh fish converge.
"Ha, this only accounts for about one-third of Yangcheng’s pre-apocalypse variety." Mr. Long casually waved, not caring about boasting, with a touch of Versailles flair.

chapters.title: Chapter 802 - 892: Easy Does It, Okay!
chapters.content:
Chapter 802: Chapter 892: Easy Does It, Okay!
The kinds that also moved Jing Shu, like tuna, Canadian geoduck, and tiger crab, unfortunately, can’t be traded as they are internal resources.
Mr. Long spoke with pride about this: "Our Yangcheng is considered the city with the most complete variety of seafood in the country, and we’re going to hold a seafood species exhibition next month. These endangered fish sources need to be well protected now."
"Uh... huh? Aren’t these fish meant to be eaten?"
Mr. Long looked at Jing Shu incredulously: "Eat? Ordinary ones are fine, but most of them are now second-class protected animals. What I mentioned about eating was mostly from before the apocalypse."
Jing Shu swallowed and timidly asked, "So is there a rule against eating them?"
"Well... not exactly..."
"That’s good, Mr. Long, take a look at these fish types I have and see if there’s anything you’re interested in. Maybe we can trade for some other types I don’t have, oh, the key is that they have to be delicious."
As she spoke, Jing Shu called in the Hulk from outside.
"Miss Jing, you’re carrying these fish around when you go out? Seafood is delicate; don’t suffocate them..." That would make them worthless!
At this moment, not only Mr. Long was curious, but Wu Jiang and others were too.
They saw the Hulk, which had transformed into a fish tank, directly lift the top of its skull.
Mr. Long was so frightened that he fell onto a stool in shock. This, this, this, he’d never seen a species that lifted its own skull like that.
Soon, everyone’s attention was drawn away.
Inside the Hulk, it displayed a grid of nine compartments showing some ordinary fish species that Jing Shu was ready to trade for resources, with just one or two of each kind.
"I left in a hurry this time, so I just grabbed some hardy fish and shrimp, just some ordinary stuff."
Holy crap! You call those face-sized abalones ordinary stuff?
The people around looked at Jing Shu with some strangeness, especially since they’d just been proudly showing off their fist-sized abalones. Now, don’t they feel a bit embarrassed?
"Miss Jing, what’s this, this species? I’ve never seen such a big variety of small lobsters!" Mr. Long was pointing at a basketball-sized red prawn.
"This, this is just a descendant of the $50-a-pound small lobsters I casually bought at the market before the apocalypse. Probably the grandchildren by now."
"Huh?? You call this a small lobster?" Mr. Long recalled how their museum treated regular small lobsters like sacred ancestors and was lost in deep thought.
"My friend has a pair of small lobsters as big as millstones. What’s so strange about that? Oh, maybe our fish and shrimp eat a lot and use up a lot of feed, so they grew a little bit bigger than others."
This kind of talk made others start to doubt their life choices.
"What species is this crab the size of a basketball? It looks bigger than a king crab." Another seafood industry leader, Mr. Zhang, asked with some uncertainty, feeling it looked like a regular hairy crab but not daring to admit it.
"Oh, this is just a labeled Yangcheng Lake hairy crab. Who knows where it’s actually from, but it’s spawning now. If you trade for it, you’ll make a huge profit. If not, I’ll just steam it and eat the crab roe, as they hatch too many at a time, and with their huge appetite, keeping them at home is too costly in food."
As Jing Shu casually flipped the female crab over, its eight claws flailed wildly, scaring Mr. Long into saying, "Be careful, easy there, easy!"
Then everyone saw a dense mass of eggs on the female crab’s abdomen. Regular crab eggs are like pinheads, but these are enormous, making Mr. Long’s blood boil—this is top-notch, absolutely top-notch!
Mr. Zhang gave Mr. Long a slight pull and whispered, "We have to trade for this, with so much crab roe, it’s a huge gain."
Mr. Long nodded imperceptibly, giving a reassuring look, then asked:
"And what about this one? You won’t tell me this is an ordinary green shrimp?" Mr. Long pointed at a green shrimp thicker than an arm, thinking it defied science. Why did this shrimp grow to the size of an Australian lobster?
"Yes, Mr. Long, see, I specifically picked several female shrimps, and they’re carrying a lot of shrimp roe. If you don’t want them, we’ll make a shrimp roe soy sauce noodle?" Jing Shu held the big shrimp with both hands, gently touching its full belly, filled with moving transparent eggs that seemed ready to hatch at any moment.
"Easy, easy!" Mr. Long was heartbroken, how could they treat endangered species like this? And the worst part was she wanted to eat it!
Mr. Zhang tugged at him again: "We really have to trade for this, to save endangered species. What’s with Boss Jing always wanting to eat them?"
"Oh..." Jing Shu casually tossed the big shrimp back into the Hulk’s fish tank, and from another compartment, she kept fishing and fishing until she finally pulled out a fish as big as a small shark, with teeth and a bulging belly.
The fish was outrageously plump.
"This... what is this?"
"This looks like a post-apocalyptic mutation."
Jing Shu held the flapping fish and said, "I don’t know if it’s a mutation or not, anyway, it used to be a regular crucian carp, and it’s an egg-laying fish. Look at its big belly; it’s going to lay eggs in a couple of days."
"This, this is a crucian carp? It doesn’t look anything like a crucian carp!"
Wu Jiang nodded in agreement: "Besides being called a crucian carp, it has no other carp features."
Mr. Long also examined it a few times and nodded: "It’s indeed a crucian carp. But this should be a precious mutation; those teeth are almost like a shark’s."
Jing Shu’s eyes lit up, and she asked, "So can it be traded for some internal resources?" In fact, her crucian carp were so abundant they were everywhere, and trading them for other types would be fantastic...
"Ah, this..." Mr. Long hesitated a lot. What does internal resource mean? If it were that easy to trade away, could it still be called an internal resource? But this crucian carp looks so big and its meat so succulent; the soup would surely be delicious?
The key is its full belly of eggs, not knowing how many more crucian carps could hatch from this, or how many might survive.
"You must have at least a hundred thousand eggs in this crucian carp, right? Do you know if the survival rate could reach 30%?" Mr. Long asked again, realizing it’s not the breeding season for crucian carps yet, why don’t the fish at Boss Jing’s place follow scientific timing, do both science and biology shy away from her place?
"I’m clueless, I usually let them roam freely. When they start laying eggs..." Then I catch them and make stir-fried crucian carp roe; it’s especially delicious.
No idea if there are a hundred thousand eggs, but enough to fill a big bowl each time.
As Jing Shu spoke, the crucian carp in her hand started laying eggs with a flurry.
A cascade of eggs plopped into the water, leaving everyone around dumbfounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 803 - 893: Uh, This Just Isn’t Scientific
chapters.content:
Chapter 803: Chapter 893: Uh, This Just Isn’t Scientific
And it was the kind that never stopped producing, a large cluster of fish eggs fell into the water, creating some ripples.
"They’re laying eggs, they’re laying eggs; crucian carp are externally fertilized, someone hurry and find a male fish—no, there probably needs to be several male fish... to be enough."
Mr. Long and Mr. Zhang were so excited, waving their arms and dancing around, not at all like the industry bigwigs they were, for this was truly a rare sight in the apocalypse.
Jing Shu then said, "So, are you going to trade your internal resources or not? If you do, I’ll throw in this big male crucian carp for free, but if not, I’ll take these fish eggs home for sauce."
After saying this, Jing Shu tossed the plump mother crucian carp in, then scooped around to pull out a slightly smaller male crucian carp, which was also unusually large, weighing over 20 kilograms, with shark-like teeth, thrashing about wildly creating splashes everywhere.
Jing Shu slapped down hard, with a loud "bang," the stunned crucian carp finally calmed down.
"Be gentle, be gentle, eh!"
"So, are you going to trade or what?"
"This is a pair of mutated crucian carp, incredibly rare! With a batch like this, that’s hundreds of thousands of fry at once! Yes, we can trade, we can trade!"
Hearing that, Jing Shu nodded with satisfaction and tossed the fish into the Hulk brand fish tank with a snap, "Alright, I want everything you mentioned before: tuna, tiger crabs, Canadian geoduck, Red Magic Shrimp and Peony Shrimp, fry too, as long as they’re viable breeding pairs."
"Alright, then you should come with us to the base now. We can discuss exactly what varieties to exchange during the ride, but we have to hurry and settle these fish and shrimp carrying eggs. For crucian carp that are externally fertilized, we’ll have to arrange it manually to increase hatch rates."
Jing Shu nodded, "Right, we have to hurry up."
If they’re too slow, the fish will hatch already.
Jing Shu knows her fish, they’re incredibly fast. Like the saying goes, the cart is barely moving and the soul is chasing behind, and before you realize it, there’s already a whole bunch of them.
Mr. Long couldn’t even bother with breakfast tea, and he and Mr. Zhang hurriedly dragged Jing Shu away.
Wu Jiang and the other two were left speechless, remembering that Boss Jing hadn’t eaten, so they quickly packed two servings of fresh shrimp porridge from the canteen to take along.
So what started as others coming for business ended up with Jing Shu doing business herself?
On the vehicle, Mr. Cui contacted the experts at the breeding base to prepare for the new members: "Hurry up, prepare to relocate these new species, they need to transition between waters to adapt to the temperature, recreate their ecological environment... do it with the highest, utmost standards!
Oh oh, you’re asking what’s here? Well, there’s crabs as big as basketballs, abalone larger than your plate, mutated crucian carp like sharks, giant prawns as thick as an arm, even lobsters bigger than Australian ones... you don’t believe? Just wait and see."
Mr. Cui hummed a tune, ready to let these old guys witness a spectacle.
...
The breeding base was just outside the city by a reservoir, only a little over half an hour by special car.
The breeding base was divided into several areas, Mr. Long led Jing Shu to the VIP rare species Pond No. 8.
Why was this pond so valuable?
Because it was an indoor artificial pond, not only with air conditioning to control temperature but also panoramic energizing lamps simulating sunlight and waves, oxygen rods, and even the soil was organic iron-rich, PH7 red soil.
As the lights came on, the rare and endangered species in the pond were visible, along with a lineup of experts eagerly rubbing their hands.
"Where’s the stuff?"
"Old Cui, don’t let us down, look, the pond is ready, but if what you said isn’t there... hmph hmph."
Mr. Long coughed, "Boss Jing, show these old guys something to open their eyes."
Jing Shu snapped her fingers, with a snap, Hulk lifted its top of the skull.
The experts collectively took a step back, but were then astounded by the scene in the pond.
So, Old Cui was telling the truth!
With a "pop," Hulk closed its top of the skull again.
"Payment on delivery, once I receive the goods, all this is yours."
"Of course, of course." Mr. Cui had barely finished when the old guys dragged him off to discuss what was going on and how to place these treasures.
Mr. Cui cleared his throat, "On a fine morning, a boss said she had some ordinary seafood and wanted to exchange them with us for resources..."
...
Meanwhile, as Mr. Long continued introducing things, he didn’t have that previous "I’m number one in the world" arrogance, but was full of humility:
"Boss Jing, you see, this is our internal resource, Canadian Geoduck."
Jing Shu’s eyes gleamed green, "This must taste great, right?"
Mr. Long smiled awkwardly, "For sashimi, it’s quite fine. Uh, so this pair of small ones... cough, even though they look a bit small, they’re definitely authentic geoducks, shall I give them to Boss Jing?"
Jing Shu didn’t complain about the two small misshapen geoducks, but rather took them exceptionally seriously, saying that she would take good care of them, and only then tossed them into Hulk’s pool.
In her heart, she added, they must be treated with the highest culinary standards.
Then came a pair of tiger crabs, tuna and other precious species, which Jing Shu took one by one, not minding that they seemed particularly small and malnourished, instead feeling euphorically delighted, calculating that with the Spiritual Spring’s acceleration, how long before she could eat some of this seafood?
Following this, Mr. Long took Jing Shu to scoop species she lacked from one pond to another, explaining how to breed them and what to pay attention to.
Once Jing Shu had received her goods, she prepared to hand over everything from Hulk’s interior one by one.
The experts were fully prepared, adapting the fish and shrimp to the water temperature, oxygenating, simulating the biological environment, and making records.
"Mr. Long, I’m ready to manually facilitate external fertilization," said a young man in gloves holding up both hands, with a big basin next to him filled with saline, just waiting to extract the crucian carp’s fluids and mix them with the eggs to increase the hatch rate by 20%.
After all, some of those fish are lazy, needing manual help to agitate and give them a boost.
Mr. Long nodded, then turned to Jing Shu, "Could you please scoop out the male crucian carp, Boss Jing? Don’t worry, this young man’s technique is quite good."
Uh, hearing this kind of operation for the first time, Jing Shu quickly shook her head and said, "No need to be so troublesome."
"Why, why not?"
"Look here, because they’ve already hatched! The fish eggs at our place hatch extraordinarily fast, so if we don’t separate them soon, the big fish will eat all the little ones, which is why I said we need to hurry. But don’t worry, I’ve thoughtfully separated them already."
As she spoke, Jing Shu stirred around and scooped with a large net, revealing a full net of densely packed little fish bouncing around.
On the other side were the already separated large crucian carp.
"Ah, this, this, this isn’t scientific!"

chapters.title: Chapter 804 - 894: D-Don’t Be Afraid
chapters.content:
Chapter 804: Chapter 894: D-Don’t Be Afraid
"Are these carp just this big when they hatch?"
"Oh my, who cares if it’s scientific or not, just put them down quickly, they’re about to jump out."
"Oh." Jing Shu put the fish back and said, "Then don’t bother, I’ll just put these two in the transparent ponds for you."
Saying this, with a snap of her fingers, the Hulk cells where the carp lived broke apart, jumped into the pond, and released the fish from its belly, then slipped out like liquid and reassembled into the Hulk.
Everyone could see one pond densely filled with small carp, while the other had two carp as big as sharks.
Everyone was shocked by the sight, not expecting this mutant carp to be so prolific, let alone hatching so quickly, and even then with an astonishingly high hatch rate.
There must be hundreds of thousands of fry, right? In this situation, in a few months, there’ll be another hundreds of thousands of fry... By then, they can trade the mutant carp for other fish species.
They’re going to be rich!
All the experts thought unanimously, unaware that Jing Shu was also thinking about how valuable and rare these carp were, wondering if she could exchange them for some other resources on the way?
In any case, both parties were pleased with this resource exchange. Jing Shu had exchanged a few common species for dozens of endangered species, but the breeding base wasn’t losing out, as what they gained was high-quality produce from Jingshu’s space, including breeding females and shrimp.
This batch alone could bring in millions of fry, it’s simply a huge profit.
Of course, Jing Shu didn’t lose out either. With these exchanged species, after some casual breeding, in a month there would be heaps of plump, robust, meaty, and juicy fish.
The thought of it was delightful.
The fishery suddenly gained dozens to hundreds of species, completing half of Jing Shu’s mission to travel around; she was incredibly relieved.
After saying goodbye to the breeding base, Jing Shu went to the Yangcheng cigarette factory to inspect the work.
Zhang Yicheng was already waiting at the factory gate:
"President Jing, you finally made it. Come on, I’ll take you on a tour of the factory. Oh, by the way, President Wu mentioned, thanks to you, the two grain production companies that didn’t want to sign the agreement so early saw our relationship with the fishery and rushed to sign immediately."
Jing Shu smiled, recalling the conversation they had that morning. It seemed they talked about everything except business. Was there some hidden meaning she didn’t understand?
Zhang Yicheng took Jing Shu on a tour of the factory, which was opened by Wu Jiang’s family before the apocalypse. It looked quite extravagant.
The second-floor plaza was ten meters high, and entering the building felt like stepping outdoors. There were people walking around in twos and threes, some with children playing on swings, and a children’s playground in the corner, like a daycare for employees.
Zhang Yicheng said proudly, "Employees at our cigarette factory can bring their kids to work, and meals are provided daily."
Jing Shu gave a thumbs up: "That’s great, we should arrange this as well."
The third floor had a cafeteria, the fourth a supermarket, the fifth a gym, and from the sixth floor up were workspaces, with employee dorms from the tenth floor, definitely giving off a big company vibe. Jing Shu thought of her own factory in Hainan, made of tin, and felt a pang of envy.
If she hadn’t regained her confidence from the cafeteria menu, she’d be questioning which was the main factory.
The lunch menu was three dishes and one soup, plus an insect meat patty. The dishes included wild black vegetables, green algae dishes, and spore mushroom dishes, with synthesized and enhanced meat occasionally.
Fish and shrimp meat were only available as holiday benefits.
"With meal benefits like ours, 15 Virtual Coins per day, we’re among the industry’s top. Ordinary companies only cost 3 Virtual Coins a day, having cockroach meatballs every meal."
Jing Shu nodded, acknowledging that Zhang Yicheng was right. However, Yangcheng’s living costs were 20 Virtual Coins, including synthetic meat and eggs, a standard much higher than here.
"Oh, and these are some local specialties I prepared for factory employees as a gift. Please distribute them."
"What? Oh, okay." Zhang Yicheng scratched his head, surprised that President Jing remembered. What local specialties were they? What if there wasn’t enough for everyone? He had to be smart to avoid embarrassment for the boss.
Then Jing Shu had the Hulk take out several burlap sacks from within.
Jing Shu opened a sack and tossed one to Zhang Yicheng: "Try our jujube stuffed with walnuts."
Zhang Yicheng caught a fist-sized red date with a big walnut slice inside, too astonished to speak. In this day and age, someone could still eat such a large jujube? Unthinkable. He took a bite.
The red date was very sweet, and the walnut skin slightly bitter, but together, the sweetness of the jujube and the rich flavor of the walnut merged, creating a more layered fruit scent and nutty aftertaste.
Oh my god, it tasted like first love—sweet with a hint of bitterness, leaving him wanting more after savoring it for a while.
Zhang Yicheng smacked his lips and summarized in two words: "Delicious."
Jing Shu opened another sack and tossed another: "This is a little milk date with almond inside peeled by us."
Zhang Yicheng received a thumbnail-sized red date wrapped in white milk powder, biting into it was a burst of milky sweetness, and chewing revealed the almond’s flavor, reminiscent of a little puppy licking your palm, overwhelming with sweetness and happiness.
Experiencing the philosophical meaning of life, Zhang Yicheng gave a thumbs up: "So delicious, I’m so touched."
Then, Jing Shu took out several thumb-sized milk curds: "Try these."
Zhang Yicheng was moved to tears. Who would have guessed that the things President Jing casually brought out were so delicious? What was this then?
Putting it in his mouth, the sweet milky aroma and rich tea flavor mixed; a bite—oh, there were pearls.
"This, this, feels like drinking bubble tea."
"Yes, this is bubble tea flavored milk curds. Alright, go ahead and distribute them. Everyone might not receive a lot, just a taste to try. I hope they enjoy it."
"Wow, President Jing, these are each worth a lot, no one would mind getting fewer. And it’s not flattery, but your treats are genuinely delicious."
Zhang Yicheng turned on the loudspeaker, telling people to line up for distribution.
Each person received two or three pieces of each kind, but it still amounted to a small bag. Some couldn’t bear to eat them, some slowly savored them, eyes bright as though finding a new direction in life, while others finished them in a few bites and licked their lips.
While others were still lining up for the specialties, screams suddenly came from the end of the line.
"What’s going on?"
"What kind of mess is this during President Jing’s inspection?" Zhang Yicheng cursed internally and immediately went to see what was happening, with Jing Shu following.
It turned out an employee was clutching his body, screaming in pain on the ground, with a twisted, terrifying expression.
"Doctor, get a doctor to see what’s happening. It might be a heart attack, don’t worry, President Jing, you don’t have to be scared." Zhang Yicheng quickly reassured Jing Shu.
Jing Shu: ... It seems like you’re the one scared??
Jing Shu: "It’s no use looking for a doctor now. Call the security team to maintain order, gather all employees in the second-floor plaza, and tell Wu Jiang that there is a major incident."

chapters.title: Chapter 805 - 895: Six Minutes and Six Seconds—Not a Second More, Not a Second Less
chapters.content:
Chapter 805: Chapter 895: Six Minutes and Six Seconds—Not a Second More, Not a Second Less
"Huh? Just this person got sick, is it really that serious?"
Zhang Yicheng’s voice quivered a little, his first reaction being that he was in trouble. Oh my goodness, this person’s facial features were twisted to an extreme, as if enduring something excruciatingly painful, even more exaggerated than a woman he once saw rolling on the ground with period cramps.
"No, it’s quite serious. A tick has burrowed into his body! Initially, the tick’s toxin paralyzes and causes no sensation, but after a day or two, it’s likely devoured most of his organs, surely causing him to writhe in pain on the ground.
Where there’s one, there’s bound to be another, so everyone must be checked. As for this person, I’ll handle it."
"Huh? Oh, okay, okay. Someone, arrange it quickly if you’ve heard. Wait, you’re handling it? How? Ticks are really dangerous, I’d rather call Situ Xiaoye and the people from their village, they’re not afraid..." Zhang Yicheng hadn’t even finished his sentence.
He saw Jing Shu suddenly pull out her black case from the Hulk’s strength, revealing layers of medical tools, and took out a reflective scalpel.
"I’ll extract the ticks, I have experience with this. Just hold the container for me."
"Huh? Oh... okay..."
Jing Shu said calmly, handing the still bewildered Zhang Yicheng a glass container, then swiftly tore open the employee’s clothing, flipped him over, and pinned him down with her leg to prevent struggling, saying, "There’s no anesthesia, bear with it, I’ll be quick."
Jing Shu’s leg rendered the person unable to move, making a weird ’ah-wu ah-wu’ sound.
Zhang Yicheng swallowed nervously, recalling Jing Shu kicking Situ Xiaoye onto the deck the day before.
That kick might just push the employee’s insides out, but he didn’t dare say a word.
He watched as Jing Shu’s scalpel sliced through a patch of back skin, exposing a bloated, blood-sucking tick beneath. Startled by the exposure, the tick attempted to fly away immediately.
Zhang Yicheng’s mouth hung open, pointing at the tick for ages.
But Jing Shu flipped the blade, relying solely on her hand to grab the fleeing tick.
Zhang Yicheng wanted to exclaim how dangerous ticks were, fearing they would burrow into anything! But in Jing Shu’s hand, the tick was as obedient as a grandson.
With a crisp ’crunch,’ the tick was sealed into the glass container.
In no time, Jing Shu skillfully stitched up the wound, slashing a few more times on the body.
Curiously, no lurking tick could be seen with the naked eye, yet Jing Shu’s cuts were so precise, each incision led to more tick discoveries. Another few ticks were dug out, stitched again, the procedure carried out with ruthless efficiency, leaving onlookers agape.
Some whispered quietly, wasn’t she a shareholder and executive from the headquarters? Why did she appear so intimidating?
How aggressive! Yet genuinely admirable! Some employees had stars in their eyes already.
"It’s not too severe, the organs haven’t been extensively consumed. Just administer some supplements later, that’s all. Alright, haul him away to rest."
"Yes, yes, okay," Zhang Yicheng wiped his sweat, swallowed hard, his hands trembling as he held the glass jar. Discovering ticks burrowed into the body causes hollowed-out, bloody holes; terrifying indeed.
At this moment, Wu Jiang hurried in, noticing the tick in Zhang Yicheng’s glass container, he frowned, "Has there been a tick infestation?"
"No, it’s not possible, we’ve followed protocol strictly."
Jing Shu speculated, "It shouldn’t be a mass tick escape; if it were, there would be more than a few. It’s probably a deliberate infliction, either externally or internally placed during operations."
Wu Jiang nodded, promptly arranging for an investigation, and asked Jing Shu, "President Jing advised gathering everyone at the square; the people are already gathered."
"Good, let’s go. I’ll conduct checks to ensure there are no remaining lurkers; there’s no sensation when ticks first burrow in."
So, at the second-floor square, Jing Shu examined all the employees. Those checked also picked up some local specialties handed out by this big boss, Jing Shu.
Ticks, with their unique energy points palpable in the body, could be detected from afar by the Insect King Chongchong. Hence, not much effort was needed for Jing Shu to find three more employees with ticks inside.
One by one, she operated, extracted the ticks, sutured, and Jing Shu performed the tasks with finesse, every movement fluidly executed.
In Zhang Yicheng’s glass jar, 15 ticks jumped around, Wu Jiang’s expression a mix of uncertainty, forcing a smile at Jing Shu,
"Thankfully, you came, President Jing. Otherwise, our loss wouldn’t just be a few valuable employee lives but immense social backlash and public opinion, possibly losing our cigarette manufacturing rights."
"I owe you a favor, Jing Shu, I’ll definitely get to the bottom of this incident."
Jing Shu nodded, "Start the investigation from the numbering of cigarette production, every stage is documented. This matter could escalate if maliciously drawn into the public eye; the consequences would be dire."
Jing Shu believed this was targeted at the Yangcheng cigarette factory, perhaps the factory’s gains had threatened someone else’s interests.
It seemed other cigarette factories should take note, issuing immediate notices for rectification, avoiding deliberate tick infestations. Today, she was present; if not, what disastrous repercussions might have ensued?
...
Because Jing Shu solved a major issue, Wu Jiang upgraded the scale of her evening banquet and specially included some traditional specialties with distinctive cooking methods and flavors not usually served.
Perhaps Wu Jiang knew how much Jing Shu could eat, or maybe he had something to say to Jing Shu alone; regardless, it was just Wu Jiang and Jing Shu in a large private room for dinner.
"President Jing, try this Macau roast pork." Wu Jiang diligently turned the dish towards Jing Shu.
Jing Shu picked up a piece of the crispy-skinned pork belly to taste, the exterior crunchy yet the meat tender and layered, the distinctive aroma of the fatty layers bursting in her mouth.
Jing Shu nodded in delight, praising, "Delicious, rich in texture, pleasantly aromatic, and the taste is truly unique."
Only after Jing Shu polished off a plate did Wu Jiang continue,
"This dish is freshly steamed East Starfish, all secret methods steamed for exactly six minutes and six seconds, not a moment more or less, just to highlight its singular charm, freshness! Try it, President Jing." Wu Jiang then redirected a large platter of fish.
Jing Shu peeled away the still steaming scallion garnishing to take a generous bite from the succulent, tender fish belly, finding its fresh, smooth texture downright melt in her mouth, the savory fish flavor endlessly lingering on her tongue... Mmm... Fresh and savory!

chapters.title: Chapter 806 - 896: Imperial Cuisine Renowned at Home and Abroad, Truly Unparalleled
chapters.content:
Chapter 806: Chapter 896: Imperial Cuisine Renowned at Home and Abroad, Truly Unparalleled
Not finding the right words to describe this tender sensation, Jing Shu finally just gave a thumbs-up and praised with the simplest words, "Fresh, tender, slippery, and a bit sweet, it’s so delicious!" With that, she devoured the whole fish in no time.
Boss Jing was eating well, so Wu Jiang showed a satisfied smile and continued, "Try this Guangdong-style Wenchang Chicken, it’s a famous traditional dish with a big history."
A plate with seemingly ordinary pieces of chicken each accompanied by a piece of chicken liver and ham, to be eaten together.
The tender taste of the chicken paired with the salty ham, and the liver, when chewed, dissolves, releasing its unique aroma, all the flavors bursting at this moment, enriching the soul of the taste buds. The two of them chewed silently, savoring the fragrance of the chicken.
Wu Jiang then continued with the introduction:
"The chicken, though ordinary, is cooked like White Cut Chicken, and after cooling, it’s cut into small pieces like this. Press it with chopsticks on the meat, then pour boiling secret broth over it, infusing it to achieve this flavor and texture."
"I said, this chicken has a different texture, it’s really memorable." Jing Shu smacked her lips, savoring the taste she just had, southern food is delicious for sure, but it’s not filling enough.
Only a few pieces of chicken, palm-sized.
Unlike the big plate chicken at Jing Shu’s home, which truly couldn’t be contained in one pot, with potatoes, peppers, carrots, and chicken cooked into a thick stew served with a pot of belt noodles...
Ahem.
Salt-roasted whelks, using a toothpick to pull out the plum-sized whelk meat intact, get rid of the liver, and eat it in one bite. The whelk is roasted to a slightly crispy texture. After adding secret sauce, it becomes chewy and aromatic, with a mellow and slightly sweet aftertaste, fragrant!!
"Try this Crispy Roasted Duck."
Jing Shu picked up a piece and tasted it: "The skin, flesh, and bone stay together but separate, the skin is crispy yet the meat is tender and fresh, the bone aromatic but not greasy, the chewing leaves a savory aftertaste, and even after swallowing, its rich juices linger in the teeth.."
Wu Jiang gave a thumbs-up, "Excellent review."
Yangcheng’s famous dishes were mostly served, like Apple Pearl Soup with Goji Berries, Braised Pigeon, Honey Roasted Pork, Baked Lobster with Soup, and more.
After finishing the table of dishes, Wu Jiang clapped his hands for the waiter to clear the empty plates, then a red sedan chair brought in a roasted crispy suckling pig the size of an arm, with a charred exterior but tender inside.
Wu Jiang’s heart bled; this was not originally part of the menu, but he owed Boss Jing a big favor.
Wu Jiang explained: "This now-lost roasted suckling pig was a main feature of the Man Han Banquet, also a famous court dish renowned worldwide as a marvel.
The marvel lies in the master’s skillful deboning of the suckling pig within a minute while leaving the meat intact, then washing away the gaminess with a secret medicine broth to enhance the aroma, followed by a quick ’return you pretty punch’ to tenderize the meat. Sprinkle even marinade, then massage and knead every part inside and out to infuse flavors, coat with a secret sauce, and slow roast over charcoal until the crispy skin bursts with juices.."
The aroma was irresistible, dipped in sugar and flour sauce..
Wu Jiang, speaking, also picked up a piece of crispy, soft meat cut and stuffed it into his mouth; since it couldn’t be recovered, he might as well eat his money’s worth!
"Crack" the crisp crackling sound, the roasted suckling pig’s crispy skin shattered completely, juicy tender meat somersaulted in the mouth, Wu Jiang closed his eyes savoring the long-missed taste, his taste buds fully satisfied and elevated, seemingly drifting to the ninth heaven, feeling dazed and delighted, Wu Jiang let out a contented sigh.
Is it that exaggerated?
Jing Shu also grabbed a piece of meat and took a bite, the crackling sound rang in her mouth, the crispy pigskin seasoned to perfection, after chewing for a while, a honey sweetness mingled with the savory, fatty tender meat, the rich textured layers made her involuntarily close her eyes to savor slowly, ah, this crispy, fragrant roasted meat, truly delicious.
The two said no more words, eating the roasted suckling pig, additional dips, and lettuce, basil-like leaves, garlic, etc., on the side, could be picked or dipped and eaten.
After satisfying their hunger, Jing Shu let out a satisfied burp.
Wu Jiang spread out in his chair not wanting to move, originally the menu was meant for a banquet of twenty, but the two of them finished it, he mostly ate two people’s share, Boss Jing alone consumed 18 people’s share.
It’s long been said that northern people have huge appetites, but he didn’t expect it to be this big.
It’s truly terrifying.
"President Jing, I heard from Zhang Yicheng that in a few days you’re going to the monthly Shenzhen Chamber of Commerce fair, but entry requires a net worth verification of over a billion Virtual Coins, reapplying is troublesome, and I happen to need to buy some things, so why don’t we go together?" Wu Jiang said with another burp.
"Sure, sure, I was just worried about not having a guide. So, President Wu, I’ll trouble you for these few days."
"It’s a small matter, we’re leaving tomorrow anyway, spend two days around the area, you must try the raw marinated food in Chaoshan, then experience Shunde’s culinary culture, it’s really interesting."
Jing Shu nodded eagerly, it was exactly what she wanted.
"Well.. hehe.. ahem." Wu Jiang coughed embarrassedly twice, met with Boss Jing’s belch, and Boss Jing’s indifferent reply:
"President Wu, we’re so familiar, just say anything directly, no need to be embarrassed, if I can help, I will, if I can’t, it’s useless for you to say, so no need to accommodate my itinerary."
"Not really, just on the way, on the way. Haha, President Jing, today’s matter, we found out and also didn’t find out.
But indeed it’s deliberate, someone coveting the Cigarette Factory’s big pie, bought off two people inside, secretly released a few ticks just to create a bad impact, no need to think to know they aim to revoke our qualifications. Those two have been handed over to the authorities, though we haven’t found the mastermind, I have a few arch-enemies, most likely it’s one of them."
Jing Shu nodded, it was almost as expected.
"Our factory can only be like this for now, can only heighten vigilance, but the Shenzhen factory over there also worries us, afraid of trouble, when you go to the Shenzhen factory maybe just give it a look on the way?
The key is to secretly cultivate several people as capable as President Jing, oh no, not even expect someone as capable as you, just having one-third of your prowess would suffice. This way our factories have no worries."
Facing problems is not horrifying, the fear lies in the lack of resolution.
This tick getting into the body, it wanders around.
If you make a cut, the tick moves, make another cut, the tick moves again, people are cut to death but the tick isn’t found, that would truly be fatal.

chapters.title: Chapter 807 - 897: Bro, Don’t Tempt Fate!
chapters.content:
Chapter 807: Chapter 897: Bro, Don’t Tempt Fate!
This is not nonsense; Wu Jiang has indeed encountered this before.
Boss Jing is known for more than just having a big appetite; her ability to quickly and perfectly handle such tricky emergencies is why Wu Jiang, a local bigwig, would lower himself to ask for help.
A skilled person is welcomed anywhere.
"Alright, it’s not a big deal. Pick some quick-handed people, and with lots of practice, I’ll teach them some techniques; there won’t be any problems."
"Then we’ll trouble President Jing, but... what exactly does ’lots of practice’ mean? Surely we aren’t the test subjects?" Wu Jiang was baffled by Jing Shu’s idea of lots of practice.
Jing Shu nodded as a matter of course: "How else would you do it? Testing on animals doesn’t cut it. Back when we encountered a sea of ticks in Sichuan, countless soldiers had ticks burrowing into their bodies. That’s when I honed my skills."
"Huh? Using people’s bodies as tests, wouldn’t that be too cruel?"
Jing Shu chuckled and decided not to tease Boss Wu any longer: "Why are you still on that? Don’t worry, President Wu, I have a solution."
"Oh, so you were joking, President Jing? You scared me."
...
Jing Shu returned to the five-star White Swan hotel, took a relaxing hot bath inside her Hulk, and fell asleep contentedly on her own down-feather bed.
Nothing happened throughout the night.
At 5:30 the next morning, knocking sounded persistently outside the door.
"President Jing, wake up! We need to catch the train! We’re going to be late! Come on, get up!" Zhang Yicheng’s distinctive voice rang out.
Jing Shu opened the door, yawning sleepily: "Huh? Catch what train? Are trains even running these days? Are you joking in the middle of the night?"
The surrounding air felt as if it froze again, chilling to the bone.
Seeing President Jing’s expression, Zhang Yicheng knew he was in for it. President Jing not only has a temper when waking up but she also doesn’t know what to do today? Did President Wu really forget to inform her of today’s schedule last night?
Zhang Yicheng remembered President Jing’s preferences and then cautiously said:
"We’re heading to Chaoshan today. The quickest and easiest way from Yangcheng to Chaoshan is by this one train that runs daily. Last year, Yangcheng resumed its train services, remember?
And when we get to Chaoshan, there’s breakfast like pig blood soup, noodle soup, seafood congee, and more. The breakfast there is delicious, and for lunch, one of President Wu’s friends has a meal planned..."
"Oh... alright, that works, I haven’t taken a train in a while, might as well experience it." Hearing there was breakfast calmed the ruffled Jing Shu at once.
The air resumed its normal flow again.
Zhang Yicheng breathed a sigh of relief, feeling he’d crossed a hurdle: "Yes, yes, and if you’re tired, you can nap on the train."
"Okay, I’ll just get dressed, and we can leave." With a snap of her fingers, the Hulks packed everything in no time, leaving Jing Shu to simply dress, a sight that filled Zhang Yicheng with envy.
...
The Yangcheng Railway Station was bustling with people, even though train services now run only a fraction of their pre-apocalypse schedule, and regular folks can’t afford the ride. Still, the massive population of Yangcheng filled it up.
Jing Shu looked curiously at the post-apocalyptic station, noting that most wore tank tops and shorts; Yangcheng is hot year-round after all.
Wu Jiang greeted Jing Shu with a yawn.
Meanwhile, Zhang Yicheng did a headcount. This time, Wu Jiang brought along a male secretary and two quick-handed surgeons to learn tick removal techniques.
Then there was Jing Shu, and... her twenty-five Hulks.
Uh-oh... Zhang Yicheng scratched his head; are so many massive Hulks really getting on the train? The station typically wouldn’t allow it.
President Jing truly is unique. Situ Xiaoye carries coffins everywhere, and President Jing never goes anywhere without Hulks—not just one or two, but a whole troop of them.
This world isn’t that dangerous, is it?
Zhang Yicheng asked President Wu what to do.
Wu Jiang suggested:
"President Jing, maybe just take a few of these Hulks? There might not be enough space on the train. Besides, we’ll be back in a few days. Rest assured, it’s perfectly safe; I guarantee it, nothing’s ever happened to me before, and I’ve got male secretaries and bodyguards too. They’re formidable."
Bro, don’t jinx it.
Jing Shu asked, "The train isn’t ideal for transporting them; how fast does it go? My Hulks can run on their own. No worries, I’m just used to having them with me; mainly, they’re carrying things to trade at the chamber of commerce."
Without the Hulks, she couldn’t openly use the numerous items in her space!
And if danger strikes, who would shield her?
So she must bring them, everywhere she goes.
Upon hearing it was for trading, Wu Jiang said: "Oh, running is too far, you’ll have to bring them. Hang on, I’ll contact a friend."
Wu Jiang made a call, and soon everything was sorted.
Not sure who Wu Jiang contacted, but the train station assigned the last freight car to Jing Shu to load her Hulks, leaving only the Hulk King with her, carrying the bulging items closely.
Facial recognition verified tickets automatically, while attentive train staff assisted at each car.
The train was a double-decker sleeper. The ordinary hard sleeper compartment had six beds per section, while soft sleepers had four. First-class business cabins offered more comfort, with a bed, table, bathroom, and extra space.
Zhang Yicheng booked first-class business cabins for the bosses, while he, the male secretary, and the two surgeons stayed in the neighboring soft sleeper compartment.
"President Jing, call on us if you need anything; we’re just next door."
"Alright, alright, I’ll take a nap first."
The train set off with a toot.
Jing Shu, after arranging for her "rotten mermaids" to follow discreetly and assessing the surroundings to rule out danger, lay on her berth and waited to wake up refreshed in Chaoshan for a feast.
After yesterday’s culinary bombardment, Jing Shu eagerly anticipated the upcoming meals.
Time flew by, and before she knew it, they were more than halfway there, nearing the destination.
Jing Shu, drool trickling, was dreaming of consuming legendary Chaoshan early meals like pig blood soup with dozens of choice ingredients and vegetables, fresh and sweet-tasting pig blood, barley porridge with pork offal, seafood, sprinkled with pepper for an intense flavor, and noodle soup with braised pig intestines, bacon, and scallions...
Boom!!
A massive explosion erupted next to Jing Shu’s ear, shattering her dream.
Simultaneously, an immense inertia flung Jing Shu forward, landing her into a soft liquid. After two impacts, the violent shaking finally ceased.
What was once a bright car instantly plunged into complete darkness.

chapters.title: Chapter 808 - 898: Sis, You Call This Kind of Breakfast Just Throwing Something Together?
chapters.content:
Chapter 808: Chapter 898: Sis, You Call This Kind of Breakfast Just Throwing Something Together?
Jing Shu abruptly opened her eyes to find herself completely wrapped by the Hulk, lying horizontally on the luggage rack that was knocked askew in the carriage.
Fortunately, she wasn’t injured, and it was lucky she had the habit of keeping Xiao Lu close as a protective layer.
Jing Shu got up, the train’s windows were now facing the sky: "Does this mean... the whole train flipped? Was there an accident?"
Jing Shu dared not be careless, and immediately used White Energy to cultivate dozens upon dozens of rotten mermaids, hiding them around the environment, arranging for the Hulk at the end of the train to rendezvous with her, and releasing countless insects to see the current situation outside.
Meanwhile, the train was filled with screams, cries, and general chaos.
Jing Shu opened the compartment door, stepped aside, and with one hand picked up Wu Jiang, who had landed face down in a daze, giving him a pat to dust him off. See, I told you not to tempt fate with your words. Now look what happened?
The adjacent soft sleeper compartment door also opened, with a faint light from a phone shining through, and Zhang Yicheng urgently shouted, "President Wu, President Jing, how are you all doing?"
And then he saw the image of President Jing holding President Wu with one hand.
Zhang Yicheng swallowed hard. Well, President Jing is indeed President Jing, his worry was unnecessary.
Jing Shu said, "President Wu is knocked out, Doctor, take a look."
Luckily, they brought along two doctors. After a simple treatment of the wound, the doctor woke Wu Jiang up.
At this time, the train staff and conductors were going through each carriage with megaphones, announcing:
"Dear passengers, please do not panic. The cause of the train derailment is unknown, but we have already requested assistance from headquarters and the maintenance department to come for inspection. Please tidy up your belongings, keep your valuables safe, and stay in your compartments without wandering around. Do not engage in dangerous behavior such as opening windows and doors to climb out of the train. Just wait for rescue."
"Injured passengers, please do not move to avoid further harm. Our train crew is currently counting the injured, and the train doctors are administering aid. Additionally, we request that medical personnel come to the broadcast room to participate in the rescue. There are many injured people in the first few carriages who urgently need help!"
The chaotic carriages gradually stabilized, with the screams dying down and the sound of conversations increasing as everyone started packing their belongings. Cups, suitcases were scattered everywhere.
Since the whole train was overturned, it’s now horizontal, so the beds have become vertical and unusable. Even after packing, one can only squeeze into cramped corners.
Zhang Yicheng crouched on the ground, using his phone as a flashlight, and said, "Boss, our doctors?"
Wu Jiang, holding his bandaged head, grimaced and said, "Send one over, and let the other stay on our side, rotating every two hours to ensure our own safety first."
"Alright."
And so, one doctor took a medical kit and headed to the broadcast room.
Jing Shu lay back on the Hulk-branded sofa chair, resting her chin in her hand, and asked, "Team Leader Zhang, what about your luggage?"
"Luggage? What do we men need luggage for?"
Wu Jiang also puzzled, "Yeah, I only brought a charging cable, is there a problem?"
"Oh, then you’re going to be in big trouble soon."
Zhang Yicheng was startled, "Ah, trouble? What trouble?"
"The train derailed, the power’s out, and all doors and windows are sealed shut, so there’s no way out. We’ll have to wait for rescue.
But who knows how long that will take? What about food and water? When traveling, it’s best to be prepared; at least bring some cookies and eggs for such unexpected situations."
Zhang Yicheng awkwardly admitted, "Yeah, now that you mention it, President Jing, I’m really hungry. I skipped breakfast thinking I’d wait for Chaoshan to have seafood porridge."
Wu Jiang also swallowed, "Who could have foreseen this? We used to often head to Chaoshan, Shunde, or Foshan for morning tea just like this."
Jing Shu shook her head, "That’s why I brought the Hulk for a reason."
With a snap of her fingers, the Hulk opened its top of the skull, from which Jing Shu pulled out a portable stove and a large pot of milk tea. She first heated up the milk tea and poured everyone a cup before pulling out an exceptionally large iron pot from the top of the skull.
The goose is so big, it wouldn’t fit in an iron pot... oops, going off-topic.
"Ah, this-this is a pot? President Jing, do you carry such a large pot with you?" Zhang Yicheng was so astonished his jaw almost dropped. Although Wu Jiang said nothing, from his gaping mouth, it was clear he was equally astounded. The other doctor was speechless.
Who travels with a pot? If you bring a pot, won’t you need to bring bowls, oil, seasonings, ingredients? Do you really have to bring all these? Well, actually, Jing Shu really did bring them all.
"Don’t make such a fuss. Once we start eating, you won’t think it’s too big anymore," Jing Shu snorted.
Sizzling oil in the pan, high flame, a hand cracking an egg, and in a blink, she had cracked over a dozen eggs into the pan. It was then noticed that Jing Shu extracted fresh eggs from underneath the rear of an unusually large old hen, each egg as enormous as a fist.
"This-this-this, you even brought fresh ingredients out? Is this even a thing?" Wu Jiang pointed at the fat chicken, finally realizing why Boss Jing carried live seafood yesterday because Boss Jing also carried live poultry!
Meanwhile, Zhang Yicheng understood why Boss Jing always brought the Hulk wherever she went. Inside the Hulk was a treasure trove, a complete household setup, making bringing it along feel like you have a mobile home.
Back to the point, the attention of the few quickly shifted to the eggs in the large pot. The transparent egg liquid turned white upon touching the pan, with the edges turning golden brown, and a rich aroma instantly permeated the air, attacking their olfactory senses. Sprinkling some salt and black pepper, the pan-fried golden eggs were ready.
The iron pan tilted, and the pan-fried golden eggs followed suit, as Jing Shu scooped them out with a spatula.
All of them swallowed a mouthful of saliva.
Behind Jing Shu, the Hulk surprised them like a treasure bag, as she reached in pulling out bacon, sausage, steak, meatballs, and other ingredients to pan-fry in the pot.
The potful of aromatic fried ingredients emitted their unique fragrances, blending in such a way that made everyone’s glands continuously secrete saliva.
Everyone simultaneously swallowed hard, but it was futile, the saliva still dribbled from the corners of their mouths. Zhang Yicheng licked his lips, and Wu Jiang discreetly wiped his saliva.
Fragrant, damn it’s fragrant, if it smells this good, imagine how it tastes.
Jing Shu handed out disposable plates and chopsticks, dishing up the pan-fried runny eggs, sausages, meatballs, and steaks for everyone. A sip of milk tea, a bite of sausage, another sip of milk tea, and a bite of a meatball.
"Is this, is this all for us to eat? President Jing, you’re too kind!" Zhang Yicheng almost shouted, President Jing, I love you!!
"It’s just breakfast, eat whatever," Jing Shu waved her hand, continuing to fry meatballs, chicken cutlets, and skewers for herself as she ate.
Madam, do you call this kind of breakfast just ’whatever’?

chapters.title: Chapter 809 - 899: Who Can Use the Toilet at a 90-Degree Angle?
chapters.content:
Chapter 809: Chapter 899: Who Can Use the Toilet at a 90-Degree Angle?
A few people were gobbling down their food, feeling like the past decades of their lives were wasted. The ingredients and methods might be rough, but the taste was undeniably good.
The first-class business car was filled with wealthy folks who couldn’t resist the aroma wafting through the air. Soon, they all started taking out the food they had brought.
