Some had brought rare instant noodles, and the moment they opened them, the rich aroma of Kangshuaifu braised beef filled the entire car, overpowering the other snacks and treats.
Zhang Yicheng rubbed his belly in satisfaction, "Thankfully, President Jing, you came so well-prepared. Otherwise, I’d be dying with cravings just from the smell of instant noodles."
Wu Jiang nodded in agreement, "It’s all thanks to you, President Jing, for bringing the Hulk along. Otherwise, we’d be in a terrible state right now. Your foresight was truly wise." Even the normally silent bodyguard assistant gave a thumbs up in approval.
After eating her fill, Jing Shu sprawled out on the Hulk like it was a couch, "This is what you call experience." Learn from this, youngsters—always keep yourself in an undefeatable position, ready for anything that might come your way.
Three more Hulks squeezed into the car from the rear, but no one said a word this time. Zhang Yicheng even dismantled the inconvenient luggage rack to make space for one of the Hulks, patting it gently, "This way, sir, there’s more room over here."
Jing Shu shook her head, sensing the information coming from the rotten mermaids outside the car. It was strange; the insects were all silent, only the rotten mermaids were unaffected.
In this wilderness, there should logically be plenty of bugs and insects, but outside it was very quiet, with nothing around.
At the front, where the train had overturned, it wasn’t derailed but rather lacked tracks; the rails had completely disappeared. According to Zhang Yicheng, this train ran daily, so it was fine yesterday, but today, something happened...
Deciding to observe the situation for a bit, Jing Shu cultivated a few hundred more rotten mermaids to guard the area and sent a few to scout ahead. She even dismissed her initial thought of setting off with the Hulk alone, deciding to stay and see how things unfolded first.
Danger seemed to loom ahead!
The quiet on the train didn’t last long, as soon enough, an inevitable issue arose.
"Boss, there’s no toilet in the hard sleeper section. The train conductor said they’d send someone over to dismantle our private toilet."
Zhang Yicheng, holding a small cup of water he had queued half an hour for, wiped his sweat and said, handing the cup to the boss with eager reluctance. Watching the boss gulp it down, he licked his lips, finally understanding what Jing Shu meant about being well-prepared when traveling. It’s truly a struggle now; even water is hard to come by, let alone finding a restroom.
Speaking of which, when the train toppled over, we’re walking on train walls, and the squat toilet holes have turned into wall hangings.
With the liquid free-falling, even standing up, you’d have to aim past the splash guard’s arc to pee in it. Oh man, that’s tough, but finding a spot to poop in is hopeless.
Who can go to the bathroom at a ninety-degree angle? Step forward and let Jing Shu see.
Wu Jiang was momentarily stunned, "Then let them dismantle it, but what do we do about using the bathroom afterwards?"
"Uh, should I queue in front of the broken toilet for you now? A lot of people are already starting to line up."
Jing Shu waved her hand, "Oh, this portable toilet is for you guys. Consider it a gift. I have a newer one."
With that, Jing Shu snapped her fingers, prompting the Hulk in the corner to pull out the first-generation Foldable No-Freeze Toilet Suit that Mr. Jing had made three years ago. Later, Mr. Jing had made a more perfected foldable toilet with a felt princess skirt design, leaving this first-generation one to gather dust.
Jing Shu opened the raincoat-looking toilet suit and personally demonstrated. The bottom had a large skirt-like frame, wearing it felt like a cape skirt. But when sitting on the seat, the middle had a big hole with a foldable bucket underneath; you could squat completely privately.
"Boss, you really carry a toilet with you when you travel? What don’t you bring? You must be carrying a mobile fortress!" Zhang Yicheng was floored, truly impressed.
Wu Jiang felt like slapping himself. He almost stopped Boss Jing from bringing the Hulk earlier—what kind of person does that? Thankfully, Boss Jing brought everything. Otherwise, what would he do?
"It’s just a small thing, really. I travel often, so I have experience." Jing Shu casually sipped her milk tea, fanning herself with a palm-sized fan while looking at Zhang Yicheng swallowing. Jing Shu poured him a large cup of milk tea, "Drink up, kid. You look parched."
Zhang Yicheng gulped it down, speechless with gratitude. Boss Jing, from now on, I’ll follow you! Once we get back, I’m transferring to the South Sea under your lead!!
Whatever the case, eating, drinking, and dealing with necessities remain the top priorities on a train. The train’s food supply soon ran out. At least everyone got some mashed potato cakes or mixed vegetable soup. There was still some clean water, but if help didn’t arrive by night, everyone would be going hungry.
Now the issue was that, being in an already hot and humid place, with all the doors and windows tightly shut, the stifling heat inside the train was unbearable.
"It’s so hot, open the windows, or at least the door."
"Right, it’s bad enough we’re not getting food, and only a little water each time, thirsty and hot, this is unbearable!"
"People in other cars are opening doors, why not us? Get some air, we’re not disembarking."
"Hah, want to disembark? This double-decker train has tipped over, a drop over three meters to the ground. Jump if you dare."
"Better not open the door, it’s dangerous outside in this wilderness. What if something comes in?"
In the private compartment, Jing Shu was having lunch with Wu Jiang and Zhang Yicheng.
The lunch was hastily prepared: fatty diced sausages, smoked goose, smoked chicken, smoked ham—all steamed. Plus some vacuum-packed braised pigs’ heads, braised pork elbows, braised chicken legs, and eggs were heated up, completing a quick meal. Jing Shu, satisfied, guided, "Traveling, keep meals simple and quick."
Zhang Yicheng chuckled, Wu Jiang nodded in agreement. Whatever Boss Jing said went, but they both thought, "If this luxurious meal is ’simple,’ what would her ’complex’ meals be like?"
But suddenly, Jing Shu had a craving for leek and egg pockets. So, while Zhang Yicheng and Wu Jiang stared in disbelief, she took out a pot of lush, green leeks, harvested a large basinful, and muttered, "Hmm, these will take another seven or eight days to grow back." Finally adding, "Oh, don’t follow my lead. I do as I please, no rules."

chapters.title: Chapter 810 - 900: Insect Invasion on the Train
chapters.content:
Chapter 810: Chapter 900: Insect Invasion on the Train
"No, no, Boss Jing, you’re really genuine." Zhang Yicheng quickly flattered.
Wu Jiang whispered to Zhang Yicheng, "I was wrong before. A true boss can eat whatever they want, wherever and whenever." Zhang Yicheng nodded in agreement. Chive and egg pastries aren’t rare; what’s rare is eating them at this time and place. Who else could do that?
Crunch! Zhang Yicheng took a bite of the chive and egg pastry so fresh it practically melted in his mouth, blending with the crisp, pan-fried dough. After finishing the pastry, he gnawed on a chicken butt, munching on parts Boss Jing didn’t like.
Finally, he stuffed a greasy sausage between two pastries, eating it like a meat sandwich, steam rising from his mouth, tears of joy streaming down, as he started another round of devouring. Boss Jing didn’t mind his appetite because Boss Jing could eat more.
Jing Shu suddenly stopped eating, her cheeks puffed out like a squirrel, but completely still.
She frowned, staring into the distance.
"What... what’s wrong?" Wu Jiang wiped the oil from his mouth and asked.
Everyone was captivated by the sudden change; Zhang Yicheng even anticipated something bad was coming. Didn’t you see Boss Jing even stopped chewing? Goodness, ever since the boss jinxed it, nothing good has happened.
"Something is coming." Jing Shu put down her chopsticks, quickly swallowed her food, then patted Wu Jiang’s male secretary/bodyguard:
"Go to the train car and find the conductor. Tell him to use the broadcast to notify everyone, check if anyone opened a window, and close them immediately. Also, get ready, a large number of unidentified creatures are coming our way, and there are many of them! I’ll contact the special task force for rescue now."
The male secretary looked at Wu Jiang for approval; Wu Jiang, his voice trembling, pointed to the broadcast room, "Go quickly and come back fast... Forget it, I’ll go with you. I have authority here, I’m afraid people won’t understand the situation."
Wu Jiang and the male secretary jogged away, their body fat jiggling, poor Boss Wu.
Jing Shu sent a location to the "Mutual Aid in the Middle East" group, to see if any friends nearby could assist or contact someone above to send help.
Nanhai Cigarette Factory Recruits: "It’s still uncertain what species they are; they don’t seem to pose a big threat, but there are a lot of them. There’s a train of civilians here that need protection; delay might lead to changes."
Xiangxi Corpse Chaser: "{Color} Brilliant, brilliant, looks like we have a new edible species. @Four-eyed boy, aren’t you there? Big events under your jurisdiction, you’d better be on the scene or your official hat won’t be safe."
Cockroach Meatballs Franchise Owner: "Stop joking, a new species doesn’t necessarily mean edible."
Four-eyed boy: "I’m on my way with my team, it’s a bit far. I trouble the comrades above to take charge on the scene and stabilize the situation as much as possible."
Zhang Yicheng, seeing Jing Shu finished seeking help, teeth chattering, asked, "Boss Jing, wh-what do we do now?" Another male doctor clutched his medical case tightly, leaning against Zhang Yicheng.
"We must ensure our safety first, then act within our capabilities." With that, Jing Shu stood up, revealed herself, stopped pretending, and began manually dismantling obstructive components such as horizontally placed bed boards, doors, bathroom doors. Whatever couldn’t be dismantled, she bent aside forcefully. Anyway, Jing Shu would compensate for it, and fortunately, the materials in this apocalypse weren’t the steel and iron from before, otherwise, it would’ve been difficult.
Soon, a spacious area was cleared up.
Zhang Yicheng watched, dumbfounded. He always knew Boss Jing was strong but didn’t expect this much. Suddenly, he felt an overwhelming sense of security being beside Boss Jing. What was this?
Just then, the broadcast announced that there were unidentified creatures outside, reminding the populace not to run around, stay in their respective train cars. Train staff began checking if any windows or doors were left open.
Wu Jiang and the male secretary, just back, witnessed the now empty train car, their mouths agape, not knowing what to say.
Jing Shu clapped her hands, and Hulk brand carriages No. 2 and No. 3 came in from the cargo carriage at the train’s tail, perfectly filling two single compartments. These two guys, full of supplies, couldn’t squeeze in before; now, there was space for them.
"Come in, it’s safer for all of us inside."
Wu Jiang and the male secretary’s jaws dropped even more.
The few of them entered the Hulk brand’s No. 3 passenger carriage. The confined space gave Zhang Yicheng and Wu Jiang a greater sense of security. Neon lights turned on, a cozy interior layout, single beds, dining tables, sofas, food, drinks, and living supplies all complete.
"Indeed, the boss is the boss. Seems my previous outlook was too small; having a bathroom is nothing, this is a portable villa."
Wu Jiang silently gave a thumbs-up, fully agreeing with Zhang Yicheng’s words; in terms of scope, President Jing still leads.
Jing Shu came back and forth several times, inserting the dismantled single beds into Hulk’s body, "You guys make do with bunk beds, squeeze a bit, there’s no more space."
"No need to make do, it’s better than home."
"Sorry for troubling you, President Jing."
Having set up the base camp and secured all their supplies, Jing Shu didn’t have time to eat anymore and said, "President Wu, you have authority, come with me. There might be unexpected situations later. Everyone else stays inside Hulk’s body and doesn’t go out."
Zhang Yicheng shook his head like a rattle, "I’m not going out, not stepping out even if I’m killed."
In fact, as Jing Shu and Wu Jiang prepared to set off with two Hulks, screams echoed from the far end of the train car, plunging the entire carriage into chaos, an atmosphere of anxiety and fear spreading.
Jing Shu accelerated towards the commotion, hearing along the way:
"The door in carriage 13 is broken, left open, and a bunch of basketball-sized giant insects crawled in! It’s said they bit many people to death."
"Then lock the door of our carriage tightly!"
"Locked, locked! Damn it, people from over there opened our compartment doors, too, and are running towards us!"
"Close it, don’t let those people come over!! A few of you go block the door, press something heavy against it!"
"No use, the train staff there opened the doors; they directly forced through and more people came over, bringing insects with them!"
"We’re doomed, let’s run too."
"Run to the back cars, hurry, damn it, the doors there are locked, open the door, let us through before locking it again."
"Can’t do it, if they don’t open then break down the door, call the train staff to open the door, they’re coming, open the door! Break the door!"
"Ah, the insects are here, huge insects, what are these damned insects."
"Help, save us!"

chapters.title: Chapter 811 - 901: Hurry Up, Let’s Catch More Insects!
chapters.content:
Chapter 811: Chapter 901: Hurry Up, Let’s Catch More Insects!
"What are you afraid of? There are so many of you, can’t you handle a bunch of insects? Grab your hammers and follow me!"
"What the hell is this thing? I hit it with a hammer and it didn’t react? Damn, damn, where’s my hammer? My hammer’s gone!"
"Aaaah! Run, quickly! Forget the hammer!"
The people who were organizing to take down the insects ran off with their tails between their legs.
And finally, Jing Shu made her way from Car No. 20 and ran into the train staff who had opened the carriage door to escape with a group of people. She didn’t blame them. There would naturally be accountability from the relevant departments afterward, but this also presented a moral dilemma.
If you were the train staff with the key to escape, would you choose to heroically die with a few and be honored as a martyr afterward; or would you use the key to open the door, bringing danger to more people, and afterward lose your job and face public scrutiny if you survive?
People in the safe carriage also face a moral dilemma: do they abandon everyone in the opposite carriage and watch them die or get injured, or do they open the door to let them in, risking their own lives?
Jing Shu finally saw the insects, which looked very much like Seven-Spotted Ladybirds, except as large as basketballs. Their bodies were dome-shaped with iron shells that spread into wing-like organs vibrating with a buzzing sound. But they were probably too heavy, so they could only hover a little before crawling and then hopping like grasshoppers.
They also crawl very fast, and scurry through the crowd, climbing walls like cockroaches. However, it seemed that they were startled by the screams of humans and started defensive attacks, accidentally killing people.
Besides, these insects and their wings are metallic, so when they buzz through the crowd, it’s like a running electric fan.
Imagine, hundreds of running and flying electric fans rampaging through people; isn’t it like a meat grinder? So to everyone, these things are just killing machines.
However, their mouths also spray a silvery-white liquid, splattering on people without causing any particular reaction, but it undeniably increased everyone’s fear.
Especially since this strange silver-white liquid corrodes metals like iron when encountered, the entire train is almost corroded away, and those who have gotten this liquid on themselves are scared to death on the spot.
Jing Shu quickly assessed the situation. Judging by the color and properties, if she wasn’t wrong, the liquid sprayed by the insects was metallic gallium.
This liquid reacts instantly with metals like iron, copper, and aluminum, ’consuming’ them, but doesn’t react with other materials. This explains why the train was running yesterday, but today the railway tracks have mysteriously disappeared.
Crucially, this liquid is incredibly expensive and valuable, extremely useful for dealing with an upcoming natural disaster she’s fighting against.
Encountering an insect on the road that can spit gallium, this is a fortune! Jing Shu looked at these round insects and suddenly found them unbearably cute.
What are you waiting for? These valuable insects are all mine! Before the special rescue team arrives, get as many as you can!
So Jing Shu had the rotten mermaids outside start intercepting and devouring these insects, reducing the number of insects entering the carriage. While Jing Shu was waiting, the rotten mermaid army rushing on the road finally caught up with her progress.
With this, there’s no need to fear the massive numbers of insects; the rotten mermaids can devour as many as come, and there’s no need to worry about their bellies being corroded by the insects; the liquid from these insects can’t harm the rotten mermaids, and the propeller-like wings’ damage is just gentle rain to them.
In any case, rotten mermaids are simply perfect storage units.
Jing Shu snapped her fingers in the carriage, and the Hulk decomposed into a puddle of slime. Jing Shu threw a puddle of the Hulk outward, hitting a large insect.
The insect’s sharp wings vibrated quickly, slicing through the Hulk, but the Hulk was just a puddle of liquid. It followed Jing Shu’s instructions, turning into a thin rope, first wrapping all six legs, then sealing the mouthparts, finally pressing the wings back and tying them up.
Without space to exert force, the insect struggled a bit and then settled down.
Crabs are pretty mighty, aren’t they? With eight legs to run fast and pincers that pinch painfully? But using a small rope to bind them, a waving crab can only glare.
This insect is no different.
Jing Shu nodded. Good, the method is feasible. So one Hulk transformed into many puddles of slime and began capturing insects.
The scene was still chaotic; several unlucky souls lay on the ground, some trampled to death, others with bodies incomplete from being cut by insect wings and then quietly dragged away. Some people were dragging half bodies around...
The people in the carriage wanted to escape to the back carriage, while the back carriage people were holding the carriage door tight, not opening it, resulting in a stalemate.
Taking advantage of this moment, Jing Shu pulled out a long bundle of hemp rope from another Hulk’s body and said to Wu Jiang, "You’re in charge of cutting the rope, make each one two meters long."
"Ah, oh, okay, okay, isn’t the Hulk already tied up? Do we have to tie them again?" Wu Jiang clung tightly to the Hulk in fear, although puzzled why President Jing brought so much rope while traveling, but that was not the focus now.
Anyway, it looked like lives were temporarily saved. Just as Wu Jiang thought this, an insect flew low, heading straight for him. Wu Jiang’s eyes widened, body stiffening as he thought things were over, expecting to die, when he saw Boss Jing reach out and grab it with bare hands!
Wu Jiang’s brain short-circuited instantly.
And then!
The high-frequency vibrating iron wings made an awful, ear-piercing metallic noise rubbing against Boss Jing’s black gloves, sparking gold. Boss Jing pressed gently, forcing the insect’s wings back. Then with three quick moves, it was tied up, even a bow showing, shaking her head, "Still too hard to tie, struggles too much, my hands hurt, the Hulk is faster."
Ah, how to respond to this? How can he elegantly compliment someone without it sounding like bootlicking? Wu Jiang was anxious!
And then Jing Shu turned her head, saying, "Oh, don’t be afraid, I will protect you. Even if I can’t react in time, the Hulk can protect you. Besides, there are so many insects, but only so many Hulks, so tying with rope is more efficient. Hurry, let’s catch more insects." Speaking late in her voice was a faint excitement and tremor.

chapters.title: Chapter 812 - 902: Look How Skillfully This Girl Tied Them Up—She Must Have Sold Crabs Before, Right?
chapters.content:
Chapter 812: Chapter 902: Look How Skillfully This Girl Tied Them Up—She Must Have Sold Crabs Before, Right?
Wu Jiang: "..."
What could Wu Jiang say? He could only channel his admiration, as vast as the river, into action and quickly started cutting ropes.
Jing Shu skillfully tied up an insect that had already been wrapped by a Hulk. She then tossed it inside the Hulk’s body, and the Hulk went off to find its next target.
Feeling the pace was too slow, Jing Shu summoned more Hulks from the rear of the train.
Hundreds of slimes flew everywhere, rapidly capturing insects. Although insects were still inexplicably flying and crawling in, and people in the front compartments were running around chaotically, the situation was notably better. Those around, seeing the situation under control, gradually calmed down and even praised Jing Shu:
"You guys are no match for this girl! You’re running in terror from a bunch of insects, but just look how well this girl ties them up! She must have sold crabs before!"
Jing Shu smiled slightly and said nothing.
"See, these insects are nothing to worry about; once tied up, they can’t do anything."
"Then why don’t you go try tying one up?"
"I-I-I’m wrong, I’m too scared. Their wings are terrifying, like meat grinders."
Soon enough, Jing Shu almost finished dealing with the insects in this compartment. Any that slipped through were temporarily restrained by the Hulks. Then, she reached the door of the compartment where there was still a standoff. With a bit of force, the door burst open with a "bang," sending those guarding it stumbling backward.
Jing Shu found the train staff and said, "The insects in this compartment have been dealt with. Let these people enter first, and continue guarding this door. Open it when someone needs to come through; no more large groups of insects will come through. Then, find someone to transport the wounded to the first-class compartment to see Zhang Yicheng and arrange for their rescue."
The train staff had already witnessed the whole process through the window, knowing she was the boss and the only one who could deal with these insects, so they nodded repeatedly: "Okay, okay, I’ll make sure it’s done."
Jing Shu placed a Hulk by the compartment door to stand guard, then proceeded with Wu Jiang towards the front compartments.
Wu Jiang, holding a Hulk in one arm and a phone flashlight in the other, closely followed Boss Jing. The dim compartment was blood-splattered, with severed limbs everywhere.
The horror movie atmosphere was intense. Occasionally, a few insects would crawl out from nowhere, giving a fright. However, the Hulks would quickly immobilize them, allowing Jing Shu to further tie them up and throw them into the Hulks’ bodies.
But Wu Jiang’s heart could not withstand such torment.
Carriages 12 and 11 were already empty. Jing Shu carefully checked the dozens of people on the ground to see if there were any signs of life. Five were still alive, so she sprinkled Petrification Powder to stop their bleeding and had the hulks carry them back.
Jing Shu continued forward but suddenly halted.
Wu Jiang almost bumped into her and hesitatingly asked, "W-what’s the matter?"
He saw the entire compartment had come apart; anything metal had reacted with gallium, turning into a new, crushable material. The insects dragged these materials into a black hole below. They didn’t spare the dismembered corpses on the open grass—apparently, metals were the primary choice of food, followed by any creature’s flesh.
Jing Shu silently summoned a batch of rotten mermaids, who had been wreaking havoc ahead, to take care of the remaining insects here.
"Carriage 10 is gone. Let’s ride the Hulks over."
"G-g-gone... oh." Wu Jiang felt a chill; indeed, the entire carriage was gone. He heard rustling sounds and was about to use his phone as a flashlight when Jing Shu stopped him, "Don’t look; let’s go. I don’t want you having nightmares."
Wu Jiang swallowed and said, "O-okay."
Jing Shu had the Hulks create a platform to reach carriages 9, 8, and 7, rescuing three more people who were still alive and cleaning up the remaining insects.
Finally, in carriage 6, they encountered a large number of insects and train staff using wooden doors to fend them off, along with the train conductor organizing people and giving commands. They were smart enough to realize the insects’ liquid was ineffective against the wooden doors.
"First group, pick up the doors and sweep the insects to the side. Those behind, use poles to knock them away. We have to hold out; help is coming, and victory is near!"
"The rescue team will be here soon; hang in there! Liu, you step down; you’re bleeding too much. Xiao Wang, you move up, then go find more volunteers from the passengers behind."
However, they were at the end of their rope, with most people already injured. At this critical moment, an insect somehow flew into the crowd. Its wings, like a meat grinder, instantly wounded several people, causing chaos. The insects in front also flew and ran chaotically, crashing into the crowd.
Suddenly, the compartment fell into even greater chaos.
As Jing Shu arrived, this was the scene she saw. So, she sprinted forward and commanded the Hulks to launch a full assault.
Desperate people had already resigned to their fate, with the train conductor even preparing his final words. But unexpectedly, at the critical moment,
a person appeared—not stepping on colorful clouds, but running plainly into the crowd and finding the troublesome insect. With her slender hands, she stopped it like a whirring iron fan, swiftly bound it up, and tossed the now-immobile insect behind her. Then she grabbed another one by hand..
Heavy iron lumps, weighing dozens of kilograms, were light as a ball in her hands. When faced with fierce resistance, she would slam them down. The iron insect would then behave obediently... Everyone shivered in unison.
The train, once buzzing with chaotic insects, suddenly seemed to stop. These insects were all wrapped in green slime as people watched.
The world seemed to freeze for a moment.
Until this girl, while tying up insects, looked up, smiled, and said:
"Oh, this train is now temporarily under my control. The special operations group’s rescue is on the way. Now, you’re safe!"
At these words, the conductor was moved to tears. "Are we really safe? Can we finally relax?"
Those who were still standing collapsed to the ground, choked with emotion. Previously unaffected, now in relaxation, reflections on the recent events filled them with fear.
Jing Shu nodded with a smile, "Yes, I declare, you are safe; you can relax. But from now on, follow my instructions."

chapters.title: Chapter 813 - 903: You Young People Always Can’t Run at Critical Moments, Sigh!
chapters.content:
Chapter 813: Chapter 903: You Young People Always Can’t Run at Critical Moments, Sigh!
"Great, great, we’re finally saved!"
"We’re alive, we survived!!"
"Following your command, whatever you say goes, as long as we can stay alive."
Jing Shu finished dealing with the insects in the carriage, clapped her hands, "Everyone gather your things, bring what you can, bedding, food, and other necessities without needing my reminder. I believe everyone here is quite experienced. We’re going to get off the train and move away from this area to wait for rescue. The special rescue team has already arrived."
The conductor nodded vigorously, nodded again, then finally said, "Huh? Aren’t we supposed to wait for the rescue on the train? Wouldn’t it be more dangerous if we leave? Please don’t be angry, I’m just a bit curious, it’s fine if you don’t want to say..." The conductor asked humbly.
Jing Shu explained, "These insects specialize in eating metal, eating tracks, you saw earlier, their saliva can melt metal, producing a substance that shatters upon contact. The train is filled with their food. Do you think being in the belly of their food...is like pork wrapped in fatty tissue—outside, inside are all edible materials. Do you guess if they might eat you along the way?
On the contrary, as long as they have food, they won’t actively and recklessly attack humans."
Although Jing Shu’s rotten mermaids here constantly hunted the Iron Worms, don’t forget, there’s a huge hole below Carriage 10, Jing Shu couldn’t guarantee that a large team of them couldn’t tunnel in directly from that big hole, it was indeed more dangerous.
"Oh, oh, I see, it’s indeed more dangerous to stay on the train, I will arrange for everyone to begin evacuating."
Having survived in the apocalypse for five years, people had a lot of experience in grabbing goods and evacuating, it was like not letting a goose pass by without plucking a feather.
Besides carrying their own bedding and luggage, they also took table boards between seats, benches embedded in the train, toilets from the washroom, pots, bowls, and even water buckets from the dining car. Everything they could see was taken.
Jing Shu evacuated everyone from the train, everyone carrying large bags, some dismantled parts of the train engine like generators.
Jing Shu gave an approving look, seeing these people knew how to live. Wu Jiang’s mouth twitched as he saw this, thinking it was too exaggerated, made him feel out of place for only bringing a charging cable empty-handed.
Jing Shu placed the wounded on Hulk-brand stretchers, and the crowd marched grandly towards the perimeter.
"This way, everyone follows me closely."
They only walked four or five hundred meters before some elderly people didn’t want to go further:
"You all said the train was dangerous, and full of those insects, which is why we followed you down, isn’t it enough now? We old folks really can’t walk too far, actually, I think this deserted place is less safe than being on the train."
"Yeah, even if the train is dangerous, it should be safer than here in the wild, right? Besides, we can’t compare to you young folks, we’re carrying big bags and moving bit by bit, barely able to move, why don’t we let that green monster carry our luggage and bedding for a bit?"
Just as everyone was arguing, a loud noise suddenly came from behind. Someone shined their phone flashlight over, only to see the several-hundred-meter-long train collapse with a roar and disappear while countless Iron Worms swarmed out, buzzing loudly.
The dense, overwhelming sound of the insects vibrating their wings once again reminded everyone of the fear they just experienced.
"Run!"
"Hurry up and run, there are so many insects."
"Damn, it’s too dangerous here, let’s run farther away, the insects are catching up!"
Jing Shu stood firm and chuckled, "Didn’t they just say this place was quite safe? Let the ones who didn’t want to leave just stay there."
The conductor came jogging over, wiping sweat: "Shouldn’t we hurry? Hurry and leave, too many insects over there, fortunately, we listened to you and escaped. Otherwise, it would’ve been terrifying!"
Everyone nodded with deep understanding and looked at Jing Shu with newfound appreciation for her foresight.
"No rush, with so much food they won’t come over. Besides, you all are carrying so much stuff, can you run fast?" Jing Shu thought she had left plenty of rotten mermaids as reassurance; she had just finished speaking when those who complained about not being able to walk because of too much luggage and old limbs were now running with their big bags faster than anyone else.
Jing Shu shook her head, thinking some people really don’t weep until they see the coffin, but when they see the coffin, they run faster than ghosts: "Let’s go, the rescue team has arrived, we’ll go meet them."
"Hurry up, hurry up, this pace is so slow, didn’t I always tell you youngsters to exercise more casually, in a critical moment you’re out of breath, can’t run anymore, can you?"
Quickly, the crowd divided into two extremes, the front was a group of middle-aged and elderly people, while at the back, a group of young people carried all sorts of things, panting.
Jing Shu stayed at the back, glancing towards where the train disappeared, wondering where these insects came from? It felt like they suddenly appeared around here.
Just as she was pondering, the sound of rumbling came from the front, with more than a dozen trucks arriving! Along with two armored vehicles, one of which stopped, and a strong man with a small yellow braid stepped out under the lights.
Jing Shu took one look at this person and knew it was the four-eyed boy from the group chat.
Because the four-eyed boy wasn’t an ordinary four-eyed boy but a true four-eyed boy, possessing four eyes, two sets of eyes.
Normal people have one pair of eyes. The four-eyed boy’s other pair of eyes is above his forehead, resembling large frog-like eyes, very lively. He seemed to have night vision as well since he noticed when Jing Shu waved her hand and ran over.
"Thanks for your trouble, comrade, I’ll take over from here. You mentioned the situation earlier in the group chat, so there have been large-scale insect riots again?" the four-eyed boy’s main pair of eyes looked at Jing Shu while the protruding eyes gazed into the distance.
Jing Shu shrugged, "You should be able to see it, that’s the situation. Your people aren’t enough to fill the gaps between the insects’ teeth, you’d better call for more of them quickly. However, I still wouldn’t recommend using heat weapons, after all, these insects can spit gallium, do you know how valuable that is?"
"It was only after you mentioned it that I learned. After reporting it to the higher-ups, they attached great importance to it. I’ll leave two teams here to guard the place, and get the ordinary civilians moved away. This level of warfare is beyond what civilians can get involved in. Currently, the higher-ups are implementing two plans:
One is sampling for drug testing to see which Poison Bomb or anesthetic bomb they react to, using whichever works. The other is dispatching special ability users with webs to wrap them up like your technique. If all else fails, we’ll resort to heat weapons."

chapters.title: Chapter 814 - 904: Picking Up Money with a Sack, But the Sack Can’t Hold It Anymore, You Tell Me
chapters.content:
Chapter 814: Chapter 904: Picking Up Money with a Sack, But the Sack Can’t Hold It Anymore, You Tell Me
Oh, it’s a bit of a shame if we have to switch to heavy weaponry, better to grab more before leaving.
Ah, Jing Shu regretted it, regretted not bringing all the rotten mermaids. This, this, this... just went out to buy groceries, who the hell would’ve thought you needed a sack to carry money?
This is too damn sudden.
"Hmm, that’s quite nice, I’ll leave these people to you, you go ahead." Jing Shu clapped her hands, seeing these travelers swiftly boarding the large trucks and even carrying their belongings, train benches, toilets, and whatnot onto them.
"Hmm? Comrade, what about you?" Four-eyed boy looked at Jing Shu in surprise.
Jing Shu smiled and coughed: "Oh, I need to stay here and keep an eye, in case the insects start overflowing or try to escape. If the ability is great, the responsibility is equally great. I can spare this much time. Besides, we’re almost at Chaoshan, we’ll get there on our own with my Hulk, you don’t have to worry about me."
Wu Jiang and Zhang Yicheng shivered as they followed behind Jing Shu. Hearing her say this almost made them kneel, oh my, boss, aren’t we supposed to be running instead of hanging around here?
What’s there to see here!! I’m begging you, hurry up and run, the insects are terrifying!
Four-eyed boy’s eyes sparkled with admiration: "As expected of you, comrade, then I’ll stay to check the situation with you, just as the reinforcements from over there have arrived too."
After evacuating the ordinary people, only Jing Shu with the Hulk, Wu Jiang, Zhang Yicheng and the bodyguards, and the surgeon were left on site.
After a busy day, Jing Shu’s stomach was growling with hunger, so she casually took out some golden, soft, and crispy oil-fried cakes sprinkled with thick sesame seeds and shared them with everyone, enjoying them with spicy and savory beef jerky.
Four-eyed boy couldn’t handle spicy food, but after two bites, he found it increasingly delicious, tears streaming from his four eyes, yet kept on eating, unable to stop.
When over a dozen trucks arrived again, a woman who could spit webs fell out, witnessing this scene.
Four-eyed boy, while sucking in air due to the spice, introduced: "Comrade Jing Shu, this is Sisi from the imported cocoon quilt group, you can just call her Sisi. If you need cocoon quilts, you can reach out to her."
Turning to Sisi, he said: "And this is the Cigarette Factory agent from the imported group, also comrade Jing Shu. Today, thanks to comrade Jing Shu, otherwise, none of these people might have survived."
"Hello, hello, comrade Jing Shu, we’ll need each other’s help in the future. Ah, with a brilliant and invincible ability like mine, it surprisingly doesn’t beat cockroach meatballs in demand. Usually, I can only make some cocoon quilts, it’s rare that I’m of any use today."
Sisi wore a tight black outfit, her figure alluring with alluring curves, looking almost normal, but when she clapped her hands, the dozen trucks opened their back covers, revealing heaps of dense white silk threads. Her hands moved and the spider silk nets flew on their own.
Jing Shu could see, in Sisi’s hands, there were two very thin threads, controlling the entire spider web, moving towards the dense swarm of iron worms, and Sisi hung onto the web, agile like a spider.
Shouldn’t the cocoon quilt she’s selling be called spider silk quilt? Ahaha, digressing~
Meanwhile, some onlookers snacked on beef jerky, sipping milk tea, watching Sisi’s performance. The endless web poured out from the trucks as if pulling yarn, continuously getting yanked over.
The spider silk was light, thin, and resilient, but couldn’t withstand the mass from over a dozen trucks, and controlling such an amount of silk would weigh a few tons, Sisi’s ability truly was impressive.
Four-eyed boy said: "Originally, the plan was to throw an iron net to capture these insects, but you said they eat iron and could spit gallium, so that plan was nixed. Fishing lines don’t match the resilience of Sisi’s spider silk and are hard to control, unable to capture on a large scale, but Sisi’s spider silk can’t be cut, so we brought her in. We’re all in this together, need to look after each other in the Middle East."
"Of course." Jing Shu nodded.
A few hundred meters away, a massive spider silk web descended, covering the feasting iron worms, whose legs got stuck and couldn’t move.
As they spread their wings trying to cut through the silk, more strands extended from all sides, binding them securely.
Great, just tie their wings a few times, so the electric fan can’t spin, and they’re done.
Getting Sisi to capture these insects was indeed much easier.
However, some insects still flew away, at which point Four-eyed boy would gaze at Jing Shu, chatting away, while his eyes shot precise laser beams biu~biu~.
Jing Shu swallowed the food in her mouth, then watched as the flying iron worms got sliced in half in the blink of an eye. The most impressive part was how Four-eyed boy’s top eyes could split to emit lasers; truly amazing.
After all, with billions of people in Great Huaxia, it’s normal to have a few New Humans that defy common sense, right? Jing Shu could only comfort herself this way.
Seeing Jing Shu’s surprise, Four-eyed boy explained: "Actually, my eyesight isn’t that good; I can’t see static objects, but I can see dynamic ones very clearly."
"Oh~"
Sisi openly captured insects on the ground, pulling bag after bag of silk-web bundled insects to the trucks, which then transported them away. Throughout the night, trucks loaded with iron worms disappeared somewhere.
Jing Shu secretly captured insects, with one rotten mermaid blending with the earth, devouring over twenty insects. Once a rotten mermaid finished eating insects, it concealed itself until its stomach was full of iron worms, and the night passed.
Thus, Jing Shu, who’d been asleep inside the Hulk, was woken up.
"Comrade Jing Shu, wake up, our initial task is over, it’s time to head back." Four-eyed boy gently knocked on the door of the Hulk.
Jing Shu groggily got up: "Hmm? The Iron Seeds are all captured already?? Weren’t there a lot yesterday?"
"Oh, there are still plenty, but Sisi’s silk ran out, we need to go back to replenish, and they’ve escaped into that underground cavern, which is hard to access from above, we’ll need more people down there, we’ll leave a few teams here on guard."
"Hmm, alright then, since it’s safe, we’ll head out, catch up later." Jing Shu waved, feeling a bit regretful for not catching the leader of the iron bugs after a whole night’s effort, but the rotten mermaids were full, time to go.
Going out with a sack for collecting money but not enough sacks left, really troublesome, it’s like when so much money is on the ground and you can’t pick it all up, heart-breaking.
"Comrade Jing Shu, you’re a good person indeed, a benevolent soul caring for the people. Looking forward to our Middle Eastern adventure. Goodbye!"

chapters.title: Chapter 815 - 905: Truly Impressive, President Jing!
chapters.content:
Chapter 815: Chapter 905: Truly Impressive, President Jing!
"Cough cough, alright, see you then." Jing Shu yawned and waved her hand. Through this incident, Jing Shu deeply reflected on herself and decided that when going to the Middle East to stock up, she definitely needs to take enough sacks and bring all the bodyguards. She can’t be like this time, when she didn’t take enough sacks for the goods. Isn’t it a loss?
Ah, it’s so painful that it makes breathing difficult.
"Cough, if you’re hungry, feel free to have some nang and beef jerky as a snack." Jing Shu yawned and returned to Hulk’s body. After setting a destination for Xiao Lu, she went back to sleep.
So, when Jing Shu woke up, she found, huh, they had arrived in Chaoshan!
Wu Jiang’s friends had been waiting early. Baldy ran over as soon as he saw Wu Jiang, almost wiping away tears.
"Oh dear, I was so worried. I saw on the news that the train you guys were on was the one that had trouble. I lit incense and prayed to all 360 gods in heaven, hoping nothing would happen to you. Luckily, they heard my sincere prayers and kept you safe!
A person as conscientious as you having trouble would really be unfair of heaven."
"I also thought I was going to die this time, it was so terrifying..."
Wu Jiang and his friend Bald Hui hugged each other excitedly, tears and snot flowing as they recounted what happened yesterday. Two grown men hugging each other, it was quite a sight.
Zhang Yicheng whispered to Jing Shu, "Boss Hui and President Wu’s friendship is more real than real gold and silver. If there’s anyone in this world who least wants President Wu to be in trouble, it’s Boss Hui, because President Wu owes Boss Hui thirty million Virtual Coins for goods and hasn’t paid yet."
Jing Shu nodded knowingly. So this friendship is real, with nothing fake about it.
"Come on, come on, you must be hungry, I’ve already prepared a banquet for you to get rid of the bad luck!"
"Burp~" Wu Jiang chuckled, having eaten too much meat in the morning, "No rush, let me take President Jing around and try our local snacks first."
Chaoshan, a seemingly ordinary city, but every nook and cranny hides culinary treasures.
In Chaoshan, Wu Jiang was in his element, guiding Jing Shu and the others around Literary and Artistic Street, feeling the era vibes brought by the Republic of China architecture. But because of the apocalypse, it looked more rustic.
What used to be street stalls for commoners has now become a high-end gourmet street; only those with confidence dare to come.
Wu Jiang took Jing Shu to eat street foods like water cake, rice cake, white cut goose noodle soup, oyster pancakes with whole oysters, steamed rice with the original flavor of fish, and more, trying every food on the street.
When she encountered something delicious, Jing Shu would generously order ten or eight more portions, like those oyster pancakes. She directly bought out today’s quantity, ordered five big pots. Jing Shu had never tasted anything so good!
The feeling of being able to hoard these delicious safe havens in Hulk’s body, actually storing them to eat slowly, was so blissful.
Who can understand the joy of a hamster hoarding food?
Hui Zai wanted to say to leave some room for the grand feast.
Wu Jiang smiled and thought, good brother, this is all I can do to help you. I don’t know if President Jing is half full, but I’ve pretty much digested it, we can start the meal.
After nibbling on these snacks, they then headed to a Chaoshan beef hotpot owned by Hui Zai.
The place was already crowded, and Hui Zai led them into a private room.
Beef hotpot emphasizes extreme freshness, just a step away from chomping on the cow itself. On the table was a big hotpot, with a secret beef broth and radishes, beside it were special satay sauce and various hotpot ingredients.
The masterchef sliced the beef on the spot, the knife steady and precise, the cuts evenly thick. The sliced beef was placed on a plate at a 90-degree angle to the ground, sticking firmly to the plate without falling off, retaining its moisture.
In no time, the table was filled with plates of fresh beef from various parts: neck, beef tenderloin, Shi Ren, Shi Bing, triple tendon, five-floral tendon, fat.
"You’re lucky, Hui Zai only slaughters one cow a week, the shop opens just one day a week, and they delayed opening by a day just for us. Reservations for a taste have lined up till next year." Wu Jiang rubbed his hands, salivating at the thought of the tender and chewy beef tenderloin.
Hui Zai patted his bald head and laughed, "Saving some for President Wu is expected, besides, President Wu’s friends are my friends. You start eating, I’ll go make you some handmade beef Wanzi."
As half the host, Wu Jiang introduced, "President Jing, Chaoshan food emphasizes the ultimate original flavor, this extremity also reflects in the eating method, watch."
He demonstrated by putting a plate of meat into the boiling hotpot soup using a skimmer, shaking it evenly, then scooping it out, "First dip to remove impurities, second to remove blood, third to soak and cool, take it out in seconds."
And it’s done.
Jing Shu picked up a slice of meat, the rapidly contracting texture locking in the juices, the beautiful marbled fat interwoven pattern became apparent. Now rolling it in the satay dip and placing it in her mouth, a slight chew, the savory and slightly spicy flavors instantly enhanced the beef’s freshness.
Shi Bing, crisp and refreshing, smooth and sweet; neck, marbled and juicy; tenderloin thick and bouncy, sweet and chewy; brisket fat, toothsome and smooth.
Each part had a different texture, but they all shared one characteristic: delicious, incredibly delicious!!
Later, Hui Zai came in with fresh beef balls, introducing them to everyone, "Our beef balls select the best hind leg beef, each piece requires 888 hits to form a fine meat paste, not one less, then shaped using our ancestral spoon and cooked at high temperature. These beef balls, one bite bursts with juiciness, fragrant and chewy."
Jing Shu could tell immediately that these fresh handmade beef balls were indeed delicious, much better than the supermarket’s beef balls. The firm texture was simply unbeatable.
"Cough cough, President Wu, do you think your friend could teach my Hulk how to make authentic handmade beef Wanzi? If I can’t eat these delicious balls in the future, I would be very disappointed."
Look at that, is this something a person would say? Wanting to eat beef balls so much that you’d have your pet make them for you. Truly, only you, President Jing!

chapters.title: Chapter 816 - 906: Chaoshan Raw Marinated Seafood—Once You Slurp, You Just Can’t Stop!
chapters.content:
Chapter 816: Chapter 906: Chaoshan Raw Marinated Seafood—Once You Slurp, You Just Can’t Stop!
But Wu Jiang didn’t dare to express his opinion, and he went over with a wagging tail. Shortly after, he came back and said, "My friend happens to need someone strong, so let’s try sending the Hulk over first."
If he hadn’t been holding back three million worth of goods without paying, Hui Zai would have called him crazy and wanted to beat him to death for letting a monster learn hand-made beef balls. But for the sake of their financial friendship, Hui Zai still said with a smile to try it first. After all, it’s the apocalypse; what strange things haven’t happened?
After finishing the beef hotpot, Jing Shu felt like it was just enough to fill the gaps in her teeth, leaving her wanting more. Fortunately, Hui Zai still had plenty of Chaoshan-style marinated seafood.
Wu Jiang was worried that Jing Shu wouldn’t be used to the marinated seafood, but he was overthinking. When Jing Shu put a piece of frozen marinated crab into her mouth, the rich layers of taste made it feel like eating ice cream!
Therefore, this marinated Portunus crab is also called seafood ice cream.
After being soaked and marinated with ice, the crab roe hardens and sticks to the teeth, but by pressing the tongue against the palate and sucking the roe, it instantly melts, and the fresh juice dances across the tongue!
Jing Shu’s ability to appreciate food is innate. With one suck, a piece of crab roe with translucent crab meat enters her mouth, chewed gently, and slides down the esophagus, the crab roe’s aroma lingering persistently.
Seeing President Jing gently use her tongue to extract whole crab meat with a mere touch, devouring one piece after another until the whole pot was finished, Wu Jiang only managed to suck two pieces. He quickly pointed to another plate of marinated seafood and said, "President Jing, try this too. The taste is superb, these are silver clams, with thick clam meat. They are blanched in 70-degree hot water for just 10 seconds without breaking the shell, and the salty and fresh juice bursts out at any time. Drizzle it with marinade, then suck a bit and give it a try."
Jing Shu picked up a small shell, first sucking in the juice and then slowly chewing the succulent meat into her mouth, the marinade’s aroma soaking in, making the tender flesh sweet and savory, delicious!
My goodness, sucking this marinated seafood is truly addictive, Jing Shu just couldn’t stop. This marinade concoction’s flavor is simply exquisite. You could marinate even a shoe sole with it and it would taste good.
Although Jing Shu was only half full, she managed to get the secret recipe for the marinated juice and planned to marinate a batch of seafood to savor at home! Just thinking about it is delightful!
Wu Jiang and Hui Zai discussed business for a while and signed a contract. This time, Wu Jiang generously paid a 30% deposit, making Hui Zai more enthusiastic, and took Jing Shu and the others to tour Nan Ao Pier.
Nan Ao Pier used to be a seafood production base, but now it functions as a rotten corpse insects fuel base. However, the rotten corpse insects here require fishing at sea, with cleaner land compared to the South Sea, where the land is inundated with these insects. The reasons are twofold: this place is densely populated, and the people here are more industrious. After all, the South Sea people’s fame for complacency is well known.
After touring Chaoshan, Hui Zai thoughtfully packed breakfast food for Wu Jiang and Jing Shu’s group for the next morning, including white porridge with dozens of side dishes and various noodles.
Before leaving, Jing Shu bought various local specialties, but to be honest, Chaoshan’s original-flavored delicacies are undoubtedly delicious. However, the fish rice—in which fish is steamed without removing the entrails—really wasn’t to her taste.
"Alright Hui Zai, just drop us off here. The train isn’t running, so we’ll take the Hulk to Shenzhen. We have things to do tomorrow." Wu Jiang waved his hand, acknowledging that this trip was a bit thrilling but the gains were worthwhile.
"Alright, alright. By the way, your Hulk is really excellent at pounding beef balls, with great force and speed. The balls it produces are more springy than others’. I wonder if I could hire a few just for beef ball making?" Hui Zai chuckled. Although he was a bit skeptical before, but now, the balls hammered by this device are really good, really tasty!
Wu Jiang didn’t say anything but felt a bit proud inside. He was on the same team as the Hulk, humming with contentment, "Our Hulk is really powerful, it can’t just follow you to pound beef balls, it’s a bodyguard. Alright, alright, we’re leaving."
Hui Zai waved regretfully, "Well then, goodbye. Come again next time."
The group seized the night to head to Shenzhen, arriving at the Shenzhen Cigarette Factory by the next morning. Jing Shu finally ate the long-awaited Chaoshan breakfast on the way, enjoying a luxurious ceremony of white porridge with a hundred dishes and the myriad of flavors. Who wouldn’t love such a rich and variety-filled breakfast?
The Shenzhen Cigarette Factory is not just similar to the Yangcheng Cigarette Factory; it’s identical. However, the Shenzhen one is slightly larger, slightly taller, and has slightly more employees than Wu Jiang’s factory.
The person in charge of the Shenzhen Cigarette Factory is named Wu Hai.
"President Jing, this is my cousin, Wu Hai." Wu Jiang seemed a bit disgruntled. His cousin always compared everything with him since they were young, and he could never quite match up. His cousin always had a slight edge in everything, which was exasperating!
Being overshadowed by his cousin since childhood was infuriating for Wu Jiang, but he couldn’t show it. He had to smile and graciously say: Cousin is still more capable, eh.
This time, Wu Jiang brought Boss Jing along for a reason, not contesting for fame but for dignity. Can he finally outshine his cousin this time? It’s all up to President Jing!
President Jing, go ahead!
Wu Hai was slightly taller than Wu Jiang, and even his spoken standard Mandarin was a bit more precise: "Hello, President Jing, this time we’ll trouble you to first help take a look, then assist in training the staff. Also, the auction gala starts tonight, and we will go together."
"Then let’s begin."
After much wining and dining, it’s time to get some work done.
Wu Hai gave Boss Jing and Wu Jiang a general tour of the company and then gathered all the employees. After Jing Shu checked them one by one and found no anomalies, she summoned a few surgeons for training in the medical room.
"Alright, divide into Group A and Group B. Now Group A will do suturing practice, and Group B will have the test subjects lie on the operating table. Only through ample practice and experience can you quickly locate the ticks burrowing around. To simulate the real tactile sensation and their tunneling paths, I will place real ticks on you."
The complexion of several people turned pale, what? Does it have to be this intense? It could be deadly, right?
Even as Wu Hai took a step forward, Wu Jiang calmly pulled him back: "Stay calm, cousin, this is one thing you don’t measure up to me on." Although Wu Jiang was also nervously anxious inside, but this time, he was determined to perform better than his cousin!!
